Company Description
A Serasa Experian é a primeira e a maior Datatech do Brasil. Líder em soluções de inteligência para análise de riscos e oportunidades, com foco nas jornadas de crédito, autenticação e prevenção à fraude. Com tecnologia de ponta, inovação e os melhores talentos, transforma a incerteza do risco na melhor decisão, ajudando pessoas a realizarem seus sonhos e empresas de todos os portes e segmentos a prosperarem.
Temos 22.000 pessoas operando em 32 países e a cada dia estamos investindo em novas tecnologias, profissionais talentosos e inovação para ajudar todos os clientes a maximizarem cada oportunidade. Com sede corporativa em Dublin, Irlanda, a Experian está listada na Bolsa de Valores de Londres (EXPN) e compõe o índice FTSE 100.
Job Description

  • Realizar estudos para buscar oportunidades de otimização e melhoria nos produtos com estudos estatístico;
  • Modelagem preditiva para o crescimento da performance e receita dos produtos;
  • Desenvolver estudos Ad Hoc e análises estatísticas de acordo com a necessidade do cliente;
  • Desenvolver modelos de machine learning;
  • Trabalhar com inteligência artificial generativa;
  • Iniciativas para mapear o funcionamento do negócio e buscar ativamente melhorias e eficiência nos modelos.
Qualifications
  • Visão de negócio para entender a necessidade do produto e traduzir em uma solução estratégica utilizando estatística ou métodos matemáticos;
  • Capacidade de se comunicar de forma colaborativa com as demais equipes demandantes ou de tecnologia;
  • Habilidade em mensurar e analisar os ganhos da estratégia do uso de dados;
  • Possuir conhecimentos de programação em SQL, Python;
  • Experiência em modelagem estatística;
  • Diferencial conhecimento em Spark e nuvem AWS e Azure.
Additional Information
Não atendeu todas as competências descritas na vaga? Estudos mostram que mulheres, pessoas não brancas e PcD deixam de se candidatar em vagas que não atendam 100% dos requerimentos. Aqui na Serasa Experian nós somos dedicados a criar um ambiente diverso e inclusivo. Se você gostou dessa vaga mas sua experiência não se encaixa totalmente, não se preocupe, nós te encorajamos a se aplicar de qualquer forma para que seu perfil seja avaliado!
  • Temos importantes reconhecimentos do mercado como selo Ideia Sustentável e WEPS – Empresas empoderando mulheres. Além disso, fomos considerados, pela quinta vez consecutiva, uma das empresas mais inovadoras do mundo pela revista Forbes.
  • Temos muito cuidado com o bem-estar dos nossos colaboradores! Em nossos escritórios, mantemos uma estrutura que conta com diversos profissionais e serviços ligados à saúde como massagem, RPG, psicólogo, sala de relaxamento e muito mais! Além disso, temos alguns benefícios diferenciais como licença maternidade e paternidade estendida, horário de trabalho flexível, programa de participação nos lucros e resultados e o Share Saving - programa de ações para todos os funcionários da Experian!

description:
Venha se juntar com a gente na V4 Company!
Sobre o ambiente de trabalho, é importante você saber que:

  • Somos guiados por atitudes claras e transparentes em nossa rotina, que nos permitem fazer o máximo para nossos clientes. Trabalhamos de modo colaborativo, o que significa que confiamos nas pessoas que estão do nosso lado.
  • Aqui ninguém é empregado de ninguém. O ambiente é o mais horizontal possível, possibilitando a sua autonomia para tomar as melhores decisões para as atividades pelas quais você é responsável. Não espere pelos outros aquilo que você pode fazer por si mesmo.
Alguns dos desafios que você vai encarar:

Desejável mas não eliminatório:

  • Conhecimento em Processos de Vendas.
O que mais oferecemos:
  • Ambiente vibrante, cheio de pessoas com o propósito de crescer;
  • Foco em metas, não em horários;
  • Gestão meritocrática, através de Objetivos Chave de Resultados (OKRs);

title: Pre Sales Opps
description:
Presente em 41 países e com mais de 25 mil colaboradores, a Stefanini tem como objetivo auxiliar os clientes a encontrar, por meio de soluções personalizadas, a maneira ideal para alcançar seus desafios, impulsionando a inovação digital. Atualmente, trabalhamos com mais de 500 clientes de diversos setores, como serviços financeiros, telecomunicações, serviços químicos, tecnologias, manufatura e setor público.

Acreditamos que a tecnologia pode revolucionar uma empresa e que a inovação é fundamental para impulsionar o desenvolvimento e a competitividade. Também valorizamos novas ideias e o poder de uma mente aberta, por isso reconhecemos que cada talento é essencial para a qualidade de nossos projetos e, principalmente, para o nosso progresso.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Pre-sales Operation Manager para se juntar à nossa equipe em um modelo híbrido de trabalho atuando 3 vezes por semana presencialmente na cidade de São Paulo atuando de forma estratégica e colaborativa com o time comercial e de pré-vendas, impulsionando nossos resultados através da excelência operacional.

Se você é gosta de trabalhar em um ambiente colaborativo e desafiador, esta é a oportunidade perfeita para você!

Você será responsável por trabalhar de maneira integrada ao time comercial e demais áreas da empresa, avaliar oportunidades de negócio e lidar com a gestão de capacidade da equipe de pré-vendas, apoiando no equilíbrio da carga de trabalho e na alocação otimizada de recursos.

Responsabilidades

  • Esperamos alguém que apoie a análise e priorização das oportunidades, sendo fundamental na definição de estratégias para maximizar conversões.
  • Entre suas atribuições, está a responsabilidade por desenvolver, documentar e otimizar todos os processos operacionais relacionados à pré-vendas, tais como o fluxo de propostas e a gestão de leads, garantindo eficiência e padronização dos procedimentos.
  • Assegurar a governança dos processos, promovendo a aderência às políticas, procedimentos e melhores práticas da empresa.
  • Definição, coleta e análise dos principais indicadores de performance (KPIs), criando relatórios detalhados para apoiar a tomada de decisão da liderança da pré-venda e fornecer insumos para aperfeiçoamento contínuo da área.
  • A governança de arquivos e gestão do conhecimento também é fundamental — será necessário manter documentos, modelos de propostas, cases de sucesso e outros materiais sempre estruturados e acessíveis para o time.
  • Garantir que todas as oportunidades, propostas e interações com clientes estejam devidamente registradas e atualizadas no sistema CRM, sobretudo no Salesforce, mantendo a integridade dos dados e facilitando análises precisas.
  • Apoiar Executivo com informações sobre a capacidade da equipe e as demandas em aberto, colaborando diretamente na gestão das atividades diárias.

Qualificações

  • Buscamos alguém com excelentes habilidades organizacionais e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de CRM (com experiência em Salesforce sendo um diferencial).
  • Perfil analítico, foco em eficiência, proatividade e uma comunicação clara e efetiva.
  • Experiências anteriores em operações comerciais, pré-vendas ou áreas correlatas serão valorizadas.
  • Experiência em Salesforce e em operações comerciais, pré-vendas ou áreas correlatas será um diferencial

title: Engenheiro(a) de Software Sênior (Node.js)
description:
Engenheiro(a) de Software Sênior (Node.js)

A Flash é uma Startup RHTech Brasileira, unimos tecnologia, pessoas e inovação para transformar a maneira como as empresas (e seus RHs) atuam e cuidam de seus integrantes. Desde 2018, atuamos com:

  • Gestão de benefícios (temos um cartão multibenefícios aceito em milhões de lugares no Brasil e no mundo)
  • Pessoas (nossos serviços incluem gestão de pessoas e controle de pontos de maneira descomplicada) e
  • Despesas (com a Flash, reembolsos, envio de notas fiscais e o controle das despesas corporativas são simplificados)

E nós unificamos essa experiência em uma só plataforma — acima de tudo, geramos impacto real na vida de milhares de pessoas.

Estamos em busca de um Engenheiro de Software Sênior para integrar nosso time responsável pela Plataforma de comunicação da Flash, um sistema inovador que abstrai múltiplos canais de comunicação (WhatsApp, SMS, e-mail) e proporciona funcionalidades avançadas com integração a modelos de linguagem (LLMs) para automação e inteligência. Se você é apaixonado por construir soluções de comunicação escaláveis, otimizar processos através de integração com eventos em tempo real (Kafka), e deseja atuar em uma arquitetura moderna que utiliza microserviços, essa vaga é para você!

Por que trabalhar com a gente?

  • Acreditamos que grandes transformações acontecem por meio de pessoas inconformadas, e os nossos valores são guias para nossas tomadas de decisões e crescimento alavancado:
  • Criamos valor com o Cliente
  • Resolvemos problemas com Pragmatismo
  • Jogamos Juntos
  • Entregamos Resultados Consistentes
  • Aprendemos e Transformamos

Nosso jeitinho de trabalhar:

  • Na Flash, você fará parte de um negócio em constante crescimento e transformação, com autonomia para criar, testar e transformar ideias em soluções reais que impactam empresas e pessoas em todo o Brasil.
  • Valorizamos quem busca mais do que a média: aqui, você cresce junto com o negócio, aumenta seu valor no mercado e é reconhecido por sua alta performance.
  • Trabalhamos com leveza, autenticidade e colaboração, em um ambiente informal, fluido e sem burocracias, onde grandes transformações nascem da liberdade de ser quem se é.
  • Nosso ritmo é intenso, nosso aprendizado é contínuo e cada desafio é uma nova chance de evoluir, experimentar e fazer diferente — com propósito e paixão

Sobre o time:

  • Nosso time de tecnologia é formado por profissionais que não apenas desenvolvem soluções tecnológicas de ponta, mas também estão sempre em busca de inovação e melhorias constantes
  • Aqui, você vai ter a oportunidade de impactar diretamente a vida dos nossos usuários com soluções rápidas, eficientes e escaláveis. Trabalhamos com uma stack moderna, utilizando Node.js, React, TypeScript, MongoDB e AWS

Nossos benefícios:

  • Cartão Flash com benefícios flexíveis: refeição, alimentação, mobilidade, saúde, educação, cultura e bem-estar
  • Plano de saúde
  • Seguro de vida

Join to apply for the Sales Excellence - COE - Advanced Modeling Manager role at Accenture Brasil .

**About Accenture:**
At Accenture, we believe your career is about what you want to be and who you want to be. It’s about bringing your skills, your curiosity, and your best true self to your work. Here, you’ll match your ingenuity with the latest technology to do incredible things. Together, we can create positive, long-lasting change.

**We are:**
Sales Excellence at Accenture. We empower our people to compete, win and grow. We develop everything they need to build and mature their client portfolios, optimize their deals and enable their sales talent, all driven by sales intelligence.

**You are:**
An analyst with a flair for turning data into business insights. You enjoy searching for patterns and connections in data to discover trends, root causes, and solutions. You use AI modeling to test theories and identify ways to improve processes.

**The work:**
The Center of Excellence (COE) enables Sales Excellence to deliver best-in-class offerings to Accenture leaders, practitioners, and sales teams. As a member of the COE Analytics Modeling Analysis team, you will generate business insights to help Accenture improve its processes, boost sales, and maximize profitability. You will build models and scorecards that help business leaders understand trends and market drivers, working closely with operations teams to turn these insights into user-friendly solutions.

You will:

  1. Collect and process data from functions such as Sales, Marketing, and Finance
  2. Analyze data to develop business insights that support decision making
  3. Communicate data insights clearly and concisely
  4. Develop industrialized solutions in collaboration with the COE team

**Here’s what you need:**

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills in English
  • At least five years of experience in data modeling and analysis, including:
    • Machine learning algorithms
    • SQL, R, or Python
    • Advanced Excel
    • Data visualization tools such as Power BI, Power Apps, Tableau, QlikView, Google Data Studio
  • Project management experience
  • Strong business acumen and attention to detail

**Extra credit if you have:**

  • Master’s degree in Analytics or a similar field
  • Understanding of sales processes and systems
  • Knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and BigQuery
  • Experience in Sales, Marketing, Pricing, Finance, or related fields
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce Einstein Analytics
  • Knowledge of Optimization techniques and packages like Pyomo, SciPy, PuLP, Gurobi, CPLEX

**You may also need:**

  • Ability to work flexible hours
  • Good internet connectivity and a distraction-free environment for remote work

**Job location:** São Paulo - SP

title: HR Generalist
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the HR Generalist role at Brex .

Brex is the AI-powered spend platform. We help companies spend with confidence with integrated corporate cards, banking, and global payments, plus intuitive software for travel and expenses. Tens of thousands of companies from startups to enterprises use Brex to proactively control spend, reduce costs, and increase efficiency on a global scale.

What You’ll Do

As an HR Generalist, you will be focused on taking care of our most important investment at Brex: our employees. In this hybrid role, you’ll support Brazil-based employees and complete key People Operations processes that span Brex’s global workforce. You thrive in fast-paced environments and are approachable and solution-focused. You possess a deep understanding of Brazilian labor laws and have a good grasp on Brazilian market practices and how they impact HR programs and policies. You have a passion for, and are excited about, building great companies, including implementing and managing processes and programs that help Brex employees do their best work every day.

Responsibilities

  • Global People Operations
    • Provide operational support to a dedicated global department and provide expert guidance on HR-related inquiries, troubleshooting and resolving issues, and supporting employees through various milestones within the employee life cycle
    • Guide and assist employees and our partner teams through key People Operation processes such as hiring, promotions, internal transfers, leaves of absences, and separations - while managing and completing these actions in Workday and Jira.
  • Brazil People Operations
    • Act as the primary point of contact for Brazil-based employees, providing timely and accurate support on HR policies, processes, and programs.
    • Utilize knowledge of Brazil labor laws and market employment best practices to interpret Brazil labor laws and regulations into actionable guidelines for Brex; collaborate with employment counsel to ensure programs and policies are compliant.
    • Drive key Brazil People Operations processes such as annual union contributions, and support broader Brazil people programs including dissídio adjustments.
    • Proactively partner with internal teams (benefits, compensation, payroll, recruiting, workplace) to optimize and build Brazil processes and programs, ensuring exceptional employee experience while aligning with business needs.
    • Build strong relationships with external Brazilian vendors and serve as main contact to ensure benefits and payroll run smoothly. Act as liaison between brokers, internal teams, and employees to resolve issues as needed.
    • Responsible for monitoring union updates to effectively communicate and implement any CBA-related obligations.
    • Ensure compliance with applicable labor regulations by tracking, preparing, and maintaining all required reports and documentation.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree is required
  • 4+ years of HR experience in Brazil, working with HRIS, benefits, payroll, LOAs
  • Significant understanding of Brazil labor laws
  • Proven knowledge and passion for implementing HR policies and programs from the ground up, and enhancing existing processes to drive operational efficiency and employee satisfaction
  • Strong communication skills in English, including reading, writing, and speaking
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities, maintaining attention to detail and accuracy
  • Discretion, integrity, and judgment in handling confidential information
  • Strong familiarity with HRIS systems and tools
  • Able to build trust and rapport quickly
  • Experience working in high-growth global technology companies
  • Power user of Google Suite

Bonus Points

  • Experience with Workday and Jira
  • Experience supporting a global workforce, including employees based in the United States & Canada
  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills (e.g., IF/THEN, INDEX/MATCH, pivot tables, formulas)

title: Associate Producer
description:
Overview

About High Scale — We’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition—that’s the DNA behind everything we do.

Our 120-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators produces thousands of high-impact campaigns weekly for the world’s leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we’re ready to 10x our output in 2026—and we need an Associate Producer who is the ultimate organizer, anticipating needs and keeping our high-velocity production engine running smoothly.

Why This Role Matters

Momentum, organization, and details are your playground. As an Associate Producer, you are the right hand of the Production team. You operate in the trenches, ensuring that briefs are clear, assets are organized, timelines are met, and quality is maintained.

You are the glue that holds the creative process together. While the Senior Producers look at the big picture, you ensure no detail slips through the cracks. Your work directly impacts our efficiency and speed to market. If you are a master multi-tasker looking to learn the ropes of high-end commercial production from the inside out, this is your launchpad.

What You’ll Do

  • Support End-to-End Production
    • Assist Senior Producers in managing the daily workflow of video campaigns, from project kickoff to final delivery.
    • Track the status of dozens of simultaneous projects, updating project management boards (Asana, ClickUp, Notion) in real-time.
    • Flag potential blockers or delays immediately and work to resolve them before they impact the deadline.
  • Asset Management & Organization
    • Act as the gatekeeper for creative assets. Ensure raw footage, music, scripts, and brand guidelines are organized and accessible to the editing team.
    • Perform quality checks on incoming assets from creators and outgoing deliverables from editors (checking for correct specs, spelling, and audio levels).
  • Coordinate Creative Teams
    • Serve as a liaison between the creative team (editors, designers) and the account team.
    • Translate feedback into clear, actionable notes for editors to execute.
    • Ensure creative briefs are fully populated with all necessary information before production begins.
  • Resource & Vendor Support
    • Assist in sourcing voice-over talent, stock footage, or specialized freelancers as needed.
    • Handle administrative tasks related to production, such as contract management, release forms, and invoicing.

Who You Are

  • A Rising Production Talent
    • 1–3 years of experience in production, project management, or account coordination (agency or digital media preferred).
    • You have a basic understanding of the video production lifecycle (Pre-Pro, Production, Post).
  • The Most Organized Person in the Room
    • You love checklists, spreadsheets, and color-coded calendars.
    • You have an obsession with file naming conventions and folder structures.
  • Proactive Problem Solver
    • You don’t wait to be told what to do. You see a gap in the process or a missing file, and you fix it.
    • You are "solution-first" in your communication style.
  • Tech-Savvy
    • Proficient in project management tools (Asana, Monday, ClickUp) and Google Suite.
    • Familiarity with Adobe Creative Cloud (Premiere, Frame.io) is a massive plus, even if you aren’t an editor.
  • Excellent Communicator
    • Strong English proficiency is required. You are clear, concise, and professional in Slack, email, and Zoom. You know how to chase people for deliverables without being annoying.

Perks & Benefits

  • Growth Opportunities: This is the training ground for becoming a Senior Producer. Master the details, and the path upward is clear.
  • Relentless Innovation Culture: Move fast, test constantly, and collaborate with some of the most creative minds in social media and video production.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and believe it’s key to building teams that change the world—one perfectly managed project at a time.

Planejar, executar e analisar experimentos de processos fermentativos upstream e downstream para o desenvolvimento de novos bioinsumos à base de biomassa e/ou metabólitos bioativos produzidos por Streptomyces, Bacillus e outros gêneros de interesse.   • Apoiar a transição de processos de bancada para escala piloto, em conjunto com as áreas de Scale up e Processos;

Este profissional atuará como guardião da experiência, transformando dados em insights para desenhar fluxos mais eficientes, intuitivos e que gerem maior satisfação e conversão.

Nosso parceiro da área de Seguros busca constantemente aprimorar o design e a operação dos sistemas para garantir que sejam mais escaláveis, confiáveis e eficientes. Então, o papel da pessoa CX Designer é bastante estratégico para o negócio.

Para que a estratégia seja assertiva, a pessoa CX Designer fará parte de uma equipe ágil composta por Desenvolvedores, Líderes Técnicos, Analistas de QA, Analistas Funcionais, Product Owners (PO) e Scrum Masters.

Garantir a Rastreabilidade da Jornada: O desafio central é desenhar e documentar detalhadamente o tagueamento (instrumentação de dados) em cada ponto de interação da jornada (WhatsApp/Chatbot), garantindo que todos os eventos e gargalos do cliente sejam corretamente identificados e mensurados para análise de dados e Business Intelligence.

Otimização Contínua do Fluxo: Identificar e reprojetar os pontos de fricção (pain points), drop-offs e repetição de ciclos na jornada, transformando interações complexas em experiências fluidas e de baixo esforço.

Equilibrar Automação e Experiência Humana: Desenhar flows que maximizem a resolução de problemas por automação, mas que garantam uma transição suave e eficiente para o atendimento humano quando necessário, mantendo a voz e a personalidade da marca.

  • Empatia e Customer Centricity: Capacidade genuína de se colocar no lugar do usuário para identificar pontos de dor e oportunidades de melhoria.

  • Negociação e Persuasão: Habilidade para influenciar o roadmap do produto e negociar soluções de design que equilibrem a experiência do cliente com os objetivos de negócio e as restrições técnicas.
  • Resiliência e Adaptabilidade: Capacidade de navegar em ambientes dinâmicos e lidar com feedbacks e iterações rápidas, mantendo o foco na melhoria contínua.
  • Organização e Gestão de Fluxo: Proficiência em documentar, organizar e gerenciar a complexidade de fluxos de conversação e jornadas do usuário.
  • Liderança e Proatividade: Iniciativa para conduzir pesquisas, propor soluções e atuar como líder de pensamento em UX dentro da equipe.

Requisitos técnicos (hard skills)

  • Experiência Comprovada em Design Conversacional (Conversational UX/CUX): Sólida experiência no design de chatbots, URA e jornadas no WhatsApp, incluindo a criação de flows (fluxos), scripts e personas conversacionais.
  • Mapeamento de Jornada e Fluxos: Domínio em ferramentas e metodologias para mapear jornadas do usuário, blueprints de serviço e diagramas de fluxo de alta complexidade.
  • Tagueamento e Instrumentação de Dados (Analytics): Experiência em definir a estratégia e os requisitos de tagueamento (instrumentação) para mensuração de métricas de UX e negócio (ex: Drop-off Rate, Taxa de Sucesso, CSAT conversacional).
  • Prototipação e Testes: Proficiência em ferramentas de prototipação (Figma, Miro ou similar) e experiência na condução de testes de usabilidade, A/B testing e análise heurística em canais conversacionais.
  • Conhecimento de Plataformas de Chatbot/WhatsApp: Familiaridade com as limitações e capacidades de plataformas populares de construção de chatbots e APIs de WhatsApp Business.
  • UX Research: Capacidade de conduzir pesquisas qualitativas e quantitativas para fundamentar decisões de design (entrevistas, análise de logs de conversação, pesquisa de satisfação).
  • Conceitos Ágeis: Experiência de trabalho em squads ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) e colaboração estreita com Product Owners (PO) e engenheiros.

About Us

At THE/STUDIO, our vision is to empower individuals, regardless of their expertise, to unleash their creativity and bring their unique ideas to life through the production of custom products. We are committed to delivering top-quality customized products that not only exceed expectations but also provide a seamless and awe‑inspiring experience via our exceptional team and AI‑integrated systems. By shouldering the manufacturing burdens, we liberate our customers to focus on their true passions, driving them towards remarkable success and fulfillment. Together, we turn dreams into tangible realities and shape a world where creativity knows no bounds.

Our headquarters are in Los Angeles, California, but we are a truly global company with team‑members across the U.S., Europe, South America, Africa, and Asia/Pacific. We have gone to a fully remote working platform so that we can attract the world’s best talent.

All roles at THE/STUDIO are 100% remote from anywhere in the world, as long as you have all your tools and a fast, stable internet connection!

We know that some applicants will not meet all the requirements, so we encourage you to apply anyway so we can determine if something else might be a good fit!

The Role

At THE/STUDIO, we help creators and brands bring their product ideas to life: from custom hats to packaging. Our Creative Specialists are trusted advisors to our customers: they don’t just close deals, they build long-term partnerships that fuel repeat business.

We’re looking for experienced sales professionals with a strong consultative sales foundation who can confidently manage inbound opportunities, uncover deeper customer needs, and nurture accounts over time. This role is ideal for someone who already knows how to sell, structure their day, and run a pipeline; and is excited to apply those skills in a fast‑paced, remote‑first startup environment.

As a Creative Specialist, you’ll own the full inbound sales cycle while developing repeat customers by helping them grow their own businesses through THE/STUDIO’s manufacturing solutions.

What You’ll Do

  • Consult with inbound leads to deeply understand customer goals, timelines, and long‑term needs.
  • Apply a consultative sales approach to guide customers through design, pricing, and production decisions.
  • Own and manage customer accounts with a focus on nurturing repeat business and long‑term value.
  • Maintain a structured, self‑driven sales workflow with clear follow‑up cadences and prioritization.
  • Manage your pipeline in HubSpot with speed, accuracy, and strong CRM hygiene.

  • Consistently meet and exceed KPIs and revenue targets.
  • Identify opportunities to improve sales processes, tools, and workflows as we scale.

What Success Looks Like

Within Your First Month

  • Ramp quickly and gain a strong understanding of THE/STUDIO’s value proposition and product offering.
  • Become proficient with inbound email sequencing, fast sales cadences, and CRM workflows.
  • Begin laying the groundwork for future repeat business through thoughtful follow‑ups and account notes.

Within 3 Months

  • Master how to identify, build, and nurture repeat customers with well‑defined follow‑up cadences.
  • Run a fully self‑driven, structured day‑to‑day sales workflow.
  • Proactively advise customers on how they can grow their own businesses using THE/STUDIO.
  • Demonstrate excellent CRM hygiene and clear account ownership.
  • Be recognized by teammates as someone who raises the bar and improves team productivity.

Within 6 Months

  • Own a healthy book of repeat customers who consistently come back to work with you.
  • Continuously exceed your quota and build a strong forward‑looking pipeline.
  • Identify and implement tools, methods, or sales processes that improve performance.
  • Be on track for increased responsibility and future promotion opportunities.

What We’re Looking For

  • 3–5 years of recent, quota‑carrying sales experience (not historic).
  • Strong foundation in consultative sales (Account Executive–type experience preferred).
  • Proven ability to manage and nurture customer accounts and generate repeat business.
  • Experience selling products or solutions in high‑velocity, SMB, or service‑based environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills (C1 minimum).
  • High energy, professional presence, and strong video communication skills.
  • Coachable, curious, resilient, and comfortable receiving direct feedback.
  • Interest in apparel, custom products, or manufacturing is a strong plus.
  • Experience collaborating with design teams; Adobe Illustrator knowledge is an advantage.
  • Highly organized with strong CRM discipline (HubSpot experience is a plus).
  • Self‑starter who thrives in a remote, fast‑moving startup environment.
  • Comfortable working US hours (PST and EST).

Note: This role is not suited for appointment setters, BDR‑only profiles, or candidates transitioning into sales from non‑sales backgrounds.

Why You’ll Love It Here

Additional Attributes & Process

Preferred qualifications

  • Expertise in the Brazilian media market, including a sophisticated understanding of the TV ecosystem, viewership trends, and the competitive landscape of local broadcasters and streamers.

About The Job

Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today\'s dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.

As the YouTube Ads Strategy Lead, you will serve as the primary architect for YouTube’s product and business generation strategy in Brazil. Sitting at the intersection of Product and Sales, you function as a Product Lead within a commercial structure, driving the long-term roadmap for how YouTube competes for and wins advertising budgets.

Your strategy will be rooted in a deep, holistic understanding of the platform’s ecosystem—starting from user consumption behavior to inform monetization frameworks. You will be the go-to expert on the Brazilian media landscape, leveraging deep knowledge from traditional TV to social platforms dynamics to position YouTube as the premier choice for advertisers. You will translate complex internal data into actionable business intelligence, crafting the narratives that drive video products adoption and revenue growth.

Google's Large Customer Sales (LCS) teams are strategic partners and industry thought leaders to the world's leading brands and agencies. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google's full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more. As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.

Responsibilities

  • Centralize YouTube’s business generation strategy in Brazil, acting as the bridge between local sales and global teams.
  • Build a platform outlook based on user behavior, arming sales with data-driven narratives that connect consumption patterns to brand buying strategies.
  • Co-lead the annual plan, prioritizing and communicating Brazil’s business requirements to global product and engineering stakeholders.
  • Analyze data and market trends to identify opportunities, developing strategies to reach business goals.

title: Supply Chain Analyst - Capacity Planning
description:
About Latitude.sh

Latitude.sh global computing platform was launched in 2019, enabling businesses to programmatically deploy single-tenant Bare Metal instances in different parts of the world.

We are a team of passionate individuals about hardware, software, and network infrastructure looking to build the fastest, easiest-to-use, developer-centric single‑tenant Cloud infrastructure. If you share this passion, join our growing team of talented people and help build the future of the Internet.

Summary

The Supply Chain Analyst will play a key role in developing and managing Latitude.sh’s capacity planning and vendor analysis framework across global data center operations — including space, power, network, and servers. Working closely with Procurement, Operations, and Finance teams, the analyst will anticipate capacity requirements, evaluate vendor proposals, and deliver clear reporting that guides infrastructure and procurement strategy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Capacity Planning & Forecasting
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive capacity planning models for data center space, power, servers, and network resources such as IP transit and backbone connectivity.
  • Forecast utilization to identify where capacity constraints may occur across the global portfolio.
  • Track provisioned versus active usage and provide early visibility into expansion needs.
  • Maintain dashboards showing available capacity, forecasted growth, and expected exhaustion timelines by site and service type.
  • Vendor Evaluation & Cost Analysis
  • Analyze and compare vendor proposals and quotes for data center colocation, IP transit, backbone, and related network services.
  • Build standardized cost‑comparison models to identify the most cost‑efficient vendor options.
  • Support procurement decisions with clear, data‑driven recommendations and total cost analyses.
  • Monitor vendor pricing, terms, and performance to ensure competitiveness and long‑term value.
  • Operational Reporting & Insights
  • Develop and manage a monthly reporting package or dashboard showing month‑over‑month and year‑over‑year variances in data center and network costs, and aggregate breakdowns by region, vendor, and service category.
  • Compare committed capacity versus billed actuals to identify underutilized or overextended resources and ensure full use of contracted commitments.
  • Validate and reconcile data across Finance and Operations to ensure reporting accuracy.
  • Present insights and recommendations that inform vendor selection, cost optimization, and capacity planning across teams.

Skills And Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Finance, Engineering, Economics, or a related field (or equivalent combination of education and work experience).
  • 2+ years of experience in supply chain analysis, capacity planning, cost management, or financial analysis, ideally within technology, telecommunications, or data center environments.
  • Strong proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets (pivot tables, lookups, scenario modeling).
  • Experience using data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker Studio.
  • Fluent in Portuguese, with professional‑level English (written and spoken).
  • Background in data center operations, network procurement, or telecom cost modeling (IP transit, dark fiber, backbone).

Preferred

  • Familiarity with ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Oracle) and SQL or other data tools.
  • Exposure to DCIM, NetBox, or other infrastructure inventory systems.
  • Highly analytical and detail‑oriented, with strong quantitative reasoning.
  • Organized and methodical, capable of structuring complex datasets into clear insights.
  • Proactive and forward‑looking, anticipating capacity and cost challenges.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, effective with both technical and business audiences.
  • Collaborative and dependable, thriving in a dynamic, global environment.

What do we offer?

  • Competitive Compensation
  • Annual Bonus based on company and team performance
  • Meal voucher (Caju): R$805,22/monthly
  • Wellhub
  • Transportation or fuel voucher (without discounts)
  • Health Plan (Sulamérica)
  • Dental Plan (Amil)
  • Subsidies for education, certification and English courses
  • On‑site at Vila Mariana - São Paulo - SP

Why Latitude.sh?

We're a lean, agile team of passionate professionals who believe in the power of innovation and creative problem‑solving. As part of our team, you won't be lost in the crowd – you'll be an essential contributor, making a real impact from day one.

Our values at Latitude.sh guide us in all our work and partnerships. We're proud to be an inclusive company, and we welcome all applicants for our open positions, regardless of their background, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, nationality or disability. If these values speak to you, we'd love for you to become a part of our team.

Responsável pela gestão estratégica de compras de peças, componentes, equipamentos e serviços críticos para a operação e manutenção aeronáutica. Location

Recife, Pernambuco, Brazil – Hybrid Position

The Company

Komatsu is an indispensable partner in construction, mining, and industrial machinery, maximising value for customers through innovative solutions and smart technologies. Modular Mining, a subsidiary of Komatsu, leads globally in mine management technology, delivering cutting‑edge digital solutions to transform operations across the mining industry. We are a global community of engineers, technologists, and QA professionals committed to revolutionising mining with innovative, high‑impact software solutions.

Job Purpose

We are seeking a Senior QA Engineer with a strong software QA background (not hardware) to lead, build, and scale quality assurance processes for complex enterprise software. This role involves driving test strategy, mentoring team members, and championing automation and DevOps integration in a fast‑paced Agile environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the planning and execution of manual and automated functional, regression, exploratory, and system‑level tests across the software lifecycle.
  • Develop, maintain, and optimise automated UI and API test suites using Selenium, Postman, JMeter, and gRPC.
  • Integrate automated test execution into CI/CD pipelines and actively monitor stability and performance.
  • Design and execute complex manual test scenarios where automation is not feasible – ad‑hoc, usability, and integration testing.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to ensure test environments are stable, scalable, and production‑representative.
  • Document, manage, and triage defects using Azure DevOps, ensuring clarity and timely resolution.
  • Act as a quality owner for key product features, ensuring traceability from requirements to release.
  • Build and maintain a scalable, reusable automation test library and produce meaningful test coverage reports.
  • Mentor junior QA engineers in both manual and automated test design, process, and tooling.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and propose tools or scripts to enhance QA efficiency and accuracy.

Required Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field (Master’s preferred).
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in software QA, including 1–2 years in a senior or lead role.
  • Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and CI/CD practices.

title: Creative PR Manager, Global Communications
description:
Creative PR Manager, Global Communications

Responsibilities

About the Team
TikTok’s Global Communications team is charged with telling the company's story and protecting the public trust that is fundamental to TikTok’s success. The team works across all business functions and regions to clearly articulate what TikTok is, what it stands for, and how it operates. Through clear, authentic, and purposeful storytelling, Global Comms engages the many audiences that interact with the platform, including global media, policymakers, key opinion leaders, professional creators, communities, and businesses of all sizes. Joining Global Communications offers a rare opportunity to operate at the intersection of technology and culture, shaping global conversations around the world.

About the Role
TikTok’s Global Communications team is looking for a strategic, hands‑on Creative PR Manager to join our Latin America team, based in Brazil. This role sits at the intersection of culture, technology, and reputation, playing a key part in shaping TikTok’s public narrative across the region.

If you thrive in fast‑paced environments, think big while executing with precision, and love building stories that travel across culture, media, and business, this role is for you.

  • Lead proactive, culturally relevant communication strategies that connect creators, SMBs, and audiences to the TikTok brand.
  • Act as a strategic partner to Operations, Marketing, Social, and Public Policy teams, bringing bold ideas that challenge the status quo.
  • Build strong relationships with media, key opinion leaders, and creator communities to generate distinctive, earned cultural moments.
  • Drive reputation management efforts across Latin America through innovative, insight‑driven PR strategies.
  • Translate complex policy, safety, and business topics into clear, compelling narratives for external audiences.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in communications, PR, or marketing (entertainment, tech, or related industries preferred).
  • Full professional proficiency in Portuguese and English (English is required for daily collaboration with global partners).
  • Proven experience working cross‑functionally with Marketing, Social, and Creator teams to deliver integrated communication strategies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Track record of leading creative, differentiated campaigns in competitive markets.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Ability to thrive in fast‑paced, high‑growth environments.
  • Passion for storytelling and media relations across Latin America.

About ByteDance Brazil

ByteDance is a global incubator of platforms at the cutting edge of commerce, content, entertainment, and enterprise services - over 2.5 billion people interact with ByteDance products, including TikTok.

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok’s mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We’re resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an “Always Day 1” mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

TikTok Accommodation

TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at

Vagas para os campus de Gurupi, Miracema, Palmas e Porto Nacional.

A Universidade Federal do Tocantins (UFT) divulgou o edital do concurso público para professores efetivos. Ao todo, são ofertadas 15 vagas com salários que podem chegar até R$ 14 mil, dependendo da titulação do candidato.

Os interessados podem se inscrever entre os dias 14 de agosto e 1º de setembro pelo site da Comissão Permanente de Seleção (Copese/UFT). A taxa para se inscrever é de R$ 260. Os candidatos podem solicitar a isenção de 14 a 18 de agosto.

Para o concurso de professores do campus de Gurupi, a aplicação será na própria cidade. Já as avaliações das vagas para os campus de Miracema, Palmas e Porto Nacional serão realizadas na capital.

Os candidatos também terão que passar por uma prova prática, outra de defesa de projetos de pesquisa e avaliação de títulos.

O valor da remuneração corresponde ao grau de titulação apresentada pelo candidato no ato da contratação, sendo:

Além dos salários, os aprovados devem receber um auxílio-alimentação no valor de R$ 500, para cargos com jornada de trabalho de 20h semanais, e R$ 1 mil para jornada de dedicação exclusiva.

Vagas e provas

As vagas estão distribuídas em diversas áreas, como Ciências Humanas, Ciências Biológicas, Ciências Exatas e da Terra, Ciências da Saúde, Filosofia, Ciências Sociais Aplicadas, Ciências Agrárias, Recursos Florestais e Tecnologia de Produtos Florestais.

Entre o total de vagas ofertadas serão reservadas quatro para pessoas negras e uma para pessoa com deficiência, distribuídas da seguinte forma:

  • 5% para pessoas com deficiência (PcD)
  • 25% para pessoas negras (pretas e pardas)

O edital destaca que não haverá reserva imediata para indígenas e quilombolas, mas esses candidatos poderão se inscrever e compor cadastro de reserva.

Veja o cronograma completo:

  • Inscrições: 14 de agosto até 1º de setembro
  • Isenção de taxa: 14 e 18 de agosto
  • Data limite de pagamento das inscrições: até 2 de setembro de 2025
  • Divulgação dos locais das provas: 16 de setembro de 2025
  • Aplicação das provas: Primeira etapa dia 21 de setembro e segunda etapa a definir

title: Creative Strategist (DTC E-Commerce)
description:
Creative Strategist (DTC E-Commerce)

Location: Remote

Working Hours: Monday to Friday, minimum 4 hours overlap with UK GMT

Contract Type: Independent contractor

You write ads that sell. You can watch a winning VSL and break down exactly why it works. You read ad comments sections for fun. You've written scripts that stopped thumbs, moved product, and hit CPA targets, and you can prove it.

If that sounds like you, keep reading.

About Purolabs

Purolabs is an independent, family-run DTC supplements brand based in South London. We have served over 350,000 customers with clean, science-backed supplements. No fillers, no additives, no nonsense. Featured in Vogue, Women’s Health, and Evening Standard, we are a profitable, fast-growing brand proving that natural wellness can be both effective and transparent.

No shareholders to impress. No cutting corners. Just a genuine mission to help people feel better.

The Role

Creative strategy is our biggest growth lever. We are hiring a Creative Strategist to own the full creative system for our paid advertising, from research and ideation through to briefing, production, and performance analysis. You will develop ad concepts, write scripts and copy, create briefs, and work with editors and creators to produce ads that convert at scale.

This is a performance role. Data guides everything. You will live inside our ad accounts, study what’s working, and use those insights to develop the next round of winning creatives. Creative instinct matters, but the numbers have the final say.

Beyond individual ad creation, you will build and refine the system itself: creative roadmaps, testing cadence, playbooks, feedback loops, and production workflows. The goal is a repeatable engine, not a series of one-offs.

Your primary focus is Meta (Facebook/Instagram). Experience with TikTok or YouTube advertising is a bonus.

What You’ll Do

Research & Insight

  • Mine customer reviews, surveys, forums, and ad comments to understand the language, pain points, and motivations of our audience
  • Monitor competitor ads, offers, angles, and landing pages across the DTC landscape
  • Turn research into clear hypotheses and test plans grounded in consumer psychology

Creative Development

  • Develop ad concepts, hooks, angles, and scripts for video ads, VSLs, and UGC content
  • Write direct-response copy for static ads, carousels, and advertorials
  • Create detailed creative briefs for designers, video editors, and UGC creators
  • Own landing page strategy and messaging for paid campaigns, working with the team to build high-converting pages
  • Build and maintain a library of proven hooks, frameworks, and winning ad structures

Performance & Iteration

  • Analyse ad account data to identify winning patterns, fatiguing creatives, and new opportunities
  • Iterate on winning ads at scale, producing variations of hooks, body copy, CTAs, and visual treatments
  • Run a tight feedback loop: learn from data, iterate on what works, kill what doesn’t
  • Present weekly creative performance reports with clear recommendations for what to test next

Process & Production

  • Maintain a strong creative cadence: roadmap, launch schedule, timelines, and quality control
  • Manage creative production flow, approvals, and external vendors
  • Build and refine playbooks, workflows, and processes to improve creative output over time
  • Collaborate with our Performance Marketing Manager, designers, video editors, and UGC creators

What We’re Looking For

Essential

  • 3+ years of experience in direct-response creative strategy for DTC e-commerce (brand-side, agency, or freelance)
  • Proven track record writing ad scripts, VSL scripts, and static ad copy that delivered measurable results
  • Strong understanding of direct-response copywriting principles (AIDA, PAS, and similar frameworks)
  • Deep knowledge of Meta Ads platform and experience working in high-volume creative testing environments
  • Experience creating detailed creative briefs and managing creative production workflows
  • Strong understanding of consumer psychology, buyer motivation, and what makes people click
  • Ability to analyse ad performance data and translate insights into actionable creative direction
  • Experience using AI tools like Claude and Gemini
  • Excellent written English, clear and persuasive

Nice to Have

  • Experience in health, wellness, supplements, or beauty DTC brands
  • TikTok or YouTube advertising experience
  • Experience casting and managing UGC creators
  • Familiarity with tools like Foreplay, Motion, Triple Whale, or Meta Ad Library
  • Landing page copywriting or CRO experience
  • Basic video editing skills (CapCut, Premiere, or similar)
  • Basic design skills (Figma or Canva) for static ad concepts

You’ll Thrive Here If You Are

  • Data-obsessed. You make creative decisions based on evidence, not gut feeling. You would rather test than argue.
  • Commercially minded. You care about ROAS and CPA, not just aesthetics. A beautiful ad that does not convert is a failed ad.
  • Fast-moving. You can produce and iterate at pace without sacrificing quality. Speed and volume matter in creative testing.
  • Proactive. You do not wait to be told what to test next. You bring ideas to the table constantly.
  • Detail-oriented. Your briefs are clear. Your scripts are tight. You spot what others miss.
  • A student of the game. You are constantly saving ads, studying hooks, and analysing what’s working across DTC.

What Success Looks Like (First 6 Months)

  • Creative strategy is fully owned and running as a consistent, repeatable system
  • You have deep customer understanding and clear positioning across the funnel
  • You have made measurable impact on ad performance through stronger creative strategy and faster iteration
  • Creative roadmap, playbooks, and production workflows are documented and running smoothly

What We Offer

  • Fully remote, work from anywhere with at least 4 hours daily overlap with UK timezone
  • Competitive rate based on experience
  • Paid time off including UK bank holidays
  • Creative freedom to test bold ideas and own your work from concept to results
  • Direct collaboration with founders, no layers of management
  • A small, dedicated team that values transparency, results, and doing things the right way
  • Products that genuinely help people feel better

How to Apply

Your application must include:

  1. Your CV in English
  2. A portfolio of ad creative work. Show us ads you have written or developed, with context on the results they drove. This can be a PDF, website, Google Drive link, or Notion page. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.
  3. A short Vocaroo recording (2-3 minutes) introducing yourself, what you have worked on, and why this role interests you. Applications without a Vocaroo will not be considered.

This is a remote independent contractor role, not employment. Applications are welcome globally.

title: Senior Solutions Engineer
description:
About You

  • You excel at navigating complex Enterprise organizations with stakeholders across different levels of seniority and including both technical stakeholders in an organization (e.g. Principal Engineers, Data Scientists) as well as business stakeholders (e.g. Risk Managers, Credit Analysts).

  • You have 3+ years of hands-on experience writing production Python code

  • You are curious and customer-centric. You enjoy learning about our customers’ and prospects’ businesses and helping them solve challenges.

  • You are able to plan and manage the technical scope of Proof of Concepts (POCs) and technical evaluations. You excel at managing multiple high-stakes prospects simultaneously while partnering with Sales to drive deals to close

  • You are humble and have a growth mindset, with a willingness to learn new skills and methodologies and bring best practices into our business.

  • You are collaborative and work well with your peers in Marketing, Sales, Product, Engineering and the Customer Success team.

  • You have a proven track record of supporting high-contract-value enterprise deals. You understand that winning an enterprise deal requires more than just good code—it requires strategic positioning, deep discovery, and the ability to handle complex technical objections.

What You'll Do

  • You discover and translate customer\'s strategic priorities and problem statements into high impact Agentic AI use cases leveraging Taktile during the sales process and throughout the Enterprise sales cycle, focusing on uncovering high-value AI use cases that justify significant investment and strategic partnership.

  • You lead the design and execution of proof-of-value projects that combine customer data, ML/AI models, and Taktile’s platform to demonstrate strategic ROI. You build technical prototypes and demos leveraging the Taktile platform that simulate production-grade integrations and workflows.

  • You collaborate with partners and customers to design and build solutions in Taktile\'s Agentic Decisioning Platform.

  • You lead proof-of-value projects and can communicate the value opportunity of a full implementation and the corresponding strategic roadmap to senior stakeholders up to C-level executives.

  • You work with product management to share competitive intelligence and prospect insights gathered during the sales process, helping shape Taktile\'s AI product roadmap and positioning strategy.

  • You create re-usable collateral, best practices & tools to help scale your knowledge and expertise across the solution engineering function.

  • You lead the discovery for new use cases and implement them on the platform to assess product-solution fit. You provide feedback to our product team and share results of your discovery with go to market functions.

Ideal, But Not Required

  • Live for Customer Value: You have at least 3-5 years of experience working within Enterprise Solution/ Sales Engineering in B2B SaaS, or in a senior technical consulting role

  • Technical expertise: You have a general understanding of REST APIs (design, integration, authentication)

  • You have experience building, tuning, or deploying ML models (e.g., scikit-learn, XGBoost, PyTorch, TensorFlow) in production settings

  • Experience with AI use cases in financial services (e.g. fraud detection, credit scoring, underwriting) is a strong plus.

  • You are comfortable explaining how a model works to both a technical stakeholder such as a CTO and domain experts such as Credit Risk Managers

  • You have acquired domain expertise in the financial services industry (banking, insurance, capital markets, payments, etc.).

Our Offer

  • Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you\'ll find yourself at home here

  • Make an impact and meaningfully shape an early-stage company

  • Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo

  • Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe.

  • Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package

  • Get access to a self-development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books or take classes.

  • Use the equipment of your choice including meaningful home office set-up.

Our Stance

  • We\'re eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We\'re looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply

  • We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won\'t inquire about how you identify or if you\'ve experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears

About Us

Taktile helps financial institutions make smarter, safer decisions with the power of AI. Our software gives teams the tools to automate complex decisions — like who to onboard, how to underwrite, or when to flag suspicious activity — with full visibility and control.

By combining AI with a rich ecosystem of financial data, Taktile enables companies to adapt their decision-making in real time as markets, customer behavior, and risks evolve.

Our mission is to build the world’s leading platform for automated decision-making in financial services — setting the standard for how AI is applied responsibly and effectively in this industry.

We were founded by machine learning and data science experts with deep experience in financial services. Today, our team works across Berlin, London, and New York, bringing together engineers, entrepreneurs, and researchers from companies like Google, Amazon, and Meta, as well as fast-growing startups and enterprise leaders.

Backed by top investors including Y Combinator, Index Ventures, Balderton Capital, and Tiger Global, along with the founders of Looker, GitHub, Mulesoft, Datadog, and UiPath - we’re building a world-class organization across all functions and levels to power the next generation of AI-driven decision-making in financial services.

title: Coordenador de Projetos & Negócios
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua nos segmentos automotivo e do agronegócio, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania, a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio, por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP), a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil, empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a Ekotruck, uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

description:
Company Overview

SCS Global Services is a pioneer and leader in the field of sustainability standards and third‑party certification, working across the economy in the natural resources, built environment, food and agriculture, consumer products, and climate sectors for over 40 years. As a Benefit Corporation, we are committed to socially and environmentally responsible business practices, and through the application of sound science, we are driving positive change.

Job Overview

Over the past two years, there has been tremendous growth in the Renewable Fuels and Circular Economy industries. Growth in biofuels and the Circular Economy has been accompanied by increased interest in certification programs designed for this industry to meet growing demand, including: ISCC EU, ISCC PLUS, RSB EU RED, RSB Advanced Products, and other similar certification initiatives.

SCS has developed standardized protocols for evaluating the greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions calculations provided by companies conducting a Life Cycle Assessment of the Carbon Intensity of their biofuels and bio‑based products. As the program grows, there is increasing demand for Life Cycle Assessment of biofuels and bio‑based products, both to develop the relevant methodologies, as well as to verify the calculations provided to SCS auditors.

About the Role

The Technical Coordinator, EBC Brazil position requires a background in a technical field (i.e., science, technology, engineering, mathematics, etc.), ideally with some knowledge of biofuel production, including biodiesel, HVO/Renewable Diesel, and ethanol, as well as a passion to work on environmental sustainability issues. This position also requires excellent organization, self‑motivation, and the ability to work independently. The Technical Coordinator supports existing ISCC and RSB certification teams, primarily conducting remote GHG reviews for these and other forthcoming programs, and providing client and operational support.

Program Areas

  • International Sustainability & Carbon Certification (ISCC)
  • Roundtable on Sustainable Biomaterials (RSB)
  • Other programs in the EBC division, as needed

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Client Support and Communication

  • Receive, process, and set up new client requests with efficiency and accuracy
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients, ensuring their needs are met promptly
  • Interface with auditors, clients, staff, and the Biofuel's certification schemes as needed to facilitate smooth operations
  • Organize and maintain client files and documentation meticulously
  • Assist in the preparation of scoping and work orders, ensuring all necessary details are captured
  • Manage daily email and Microsoft Teams communications with auditors, clients, and internal team members regularly

Audit Coordination and Planning

  • Conduct GHG reviews and deliver GHG reports and related comments to auditors and program staff on time and according to program requirements
  • Participate in internal discussions regarding GHG review issues
  • Contribute to program development and improvement of operational procedures
  • Interact with clients and audit teams to follow up on nonconformity closure when necessary
  • Perform technical duties with the support of the technical team

Operations

title: Emprego formal para professores de veterinária cresce 81,4%
description:
Idade e nível de formação impactam os salários dos profissionais | Foto: Freepik 4 min.

Acompanhe as principais notícias do dia no nosso canal doWhatsapp. Siga nosso canal

A oferta de empregos para professores de veterinária vive um momento de alta demanda , segundo informações atualizadas no início de outubro. No comparativo entre setembro de 2024 e agosto deste ano, o aumento nas contratações formais foi de 81,48%.

Os dados integram uma pesquisa realizada pelo Portal Salário , com base nos indicadores do Caged relativos a 233 profissionais admitidos e desligados em todo o Brasil nos últimos 12 meses

O perfil profissional mais recorrente é o de uma mulher de 29 anos , com formação superior em medicina veterinária , que trabalha 33 horas semanais em empresas do segmento de educação superior. Valença (RJ) é a cidade que mais apresenta vagas para esse profissional .

Continua depois da publicidade

Atualmente, um professor de medicina veterinária ganha, em média, R$ 5.702,22 para uma jornada de 25 horas semanais. O piso salarial é de R$ 5.546,49, enquanto o teto pode alcançar R$ 12.560,47 . Esses números não incluem adicionais como bônus, comissões, horas extras e adicional noturno, o que pode alterar a remuneração final do profissional .

Na avaliação de Roberto Luiz Lange , diretor da Associação Brasileira dos Hospitais Veterinários (ABHV), o piso salarial da categoria é inadequado se for considerado o investimento pessoal e financeiro para se tornar um médico veterinário, somado à especialização necessária para lecionar,

“O valor não reflete a complexidade da função, a qualificação exigida tampouco o impacto na qualidade da medicina veterinária do país. A proliferação de faculdades, muitas vezes com estruturas limitadas, pode pressionar os salários para baixo, distanciando-os do valor real do profissional”, lamenta.

Lange ressalta ainda que as condições de trabalho são muito heterogêneas e frequentemente desafiadoras. “A carga horária é intensa e vai muito além da sala de aula ”, englobando pesquisa, extensão, orientação de alunos e uma dose considerável de burocracia”, pontua.

Quanto à infraestrutura, há uma grande disparidade: enquanto algumas instituições oferecem laboratórios e clínicas de ponta, outras, especialmente as mais recentes ou com menor investimento, pecam pela infraestrutura inadequada ou desatualizada. “O reconhecimento, na maioria das vezes, é mais interno ao meio acadêmico e nem sempre se traduz em valorização financeira ou em prestígio na sociedade que corresponda à sua expertise e dedicação. É um cenário que há muito vem exigindo atenção para não comprometer a qualidade do ensino”, acrescenta.

Professores de veterinária têm maiores salários no Norte do país

Diferentemente do que ocorre em grande parte das profissões do setor, como médico veterinário, groomer e criador, em que os salários mais altos costumam se concentrar nas regiões Sul e Sudeste, no caso dos professores de medicina veterinária, é a região Norte que lidera em remuneração .

Por lá, o piso salarial é de R$ 8.065, a média chega a R$ 8.292 e o teto alcança R$ 10.043. A média no Norte é cerca de 44,5% superior à do Sudeste, que ocupa a segunda posição entre as regiões com melhor remuneração. Já o Centro-Oeste apresenta os menores valores , com piso de R$ 3.696, média de R$ 3.800 e teto de R$ 4.603.

Salário de professor de veterinária por região do Brasil (em R$)

O levantamento também revela uma relação direta entre a idade e a remuneração dos profissionais no cargo de professor de medicina veterinária. Entre os que têm 21 a 30 anos, o salário médio é de R$ 4.609. Já entre os que têm 61 a 70 anos, a remuneração chega a R$ 9.722, um aumento de 110,9% em relação aos mais jovens.

Salário de professor de veterinária por faixa etária (em R$)

Além disso, o grau de instrução tem grande impacto no valor recebido . Profissionais com doutorado têm, em média, remuneração 60,7% superior àqueles com apenas ensino superior completo.

Salário de professor de veterinária por grau de instrução (em R$)

Diferença salarial entre homens e mulheres

Numa amostragem de 233 salários de profissionais admitidos ou desligados no cargo de professor de medicina veterinária, 148 são mulheres com salário médio de R$ 5.908,71 para uma jornada semanal de 27 horas. Por outro lado, 85 são homens com remuneração salarial média de R$ 5.342,69 e jornada de trabalho de 22 horas por semana.

Graduada em Jornalismo pela ESPM e pós-graduada em Estudos Brasileiros e BI & Analytics. Tem textos publicados na Exame, UOL, Yahoo, GQ, CNN Brasil, Record TV e revista AnaMaria.

title: HR Manager
description:
As the HR Manager you will be responsible for leading and managing all people‑related programs and processes that support the organization's business goals and team experience. This is a senior role that leads hiring, onboarding, employee relations, performance systems, compensation strategy, and compliance, with a strong emphasis on U.S. employment practices. The position combines long‑term people strategy with hands‑on implementation and is suited to someone who has extensive U.S. HR experience and enjoys building systems in a dynamic environment while balancing empathy with operational rigor.

Key Responsibilities

Talent acquisition

  • Own senior‑level and critical hiring processes, including role definition, postings, sourcing strategy, screening, and offer coordination.
  • Partner with department leaders to define competencies, scorecards, and structured interview processes for U.S.-based and global roles.
  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline of experienced candidates across coaching, marketing, operations, and leadership functions.
  • Support efforts to attract diverse talent that aligns with the organization's mission and values, with particular attention to U.S. labor market dynamics.
  • Collaborate, when needed, with pre‑approved external recruiting partners to support specialized or hard‑to‑fill searches.

Onboarding and employee experience

  • Lead the design and execution of a structured onboarding experience for U.S. and international hires, ensuring clarity on expectations, tools, and culture.
  • Continuously refine the new‑hire journey to reflect the organization's brand, values, and distributed, often remote, workforce.
  • Partner with leaders to foster strong cross‑functional communication and collaboration across time zones and locations.
  • Support and help design engagement initiatives, team development activities, and culture‑building practices.

Compensation, benefits, and HR operations

  • Oversee HR operations for U.S. employees, including payroll changes, employee records, and HR platforms, with a focus on accuracy and confidentiality.
  • Partner with leadership to develop and refine compensation strategies, conduct U.S. market benchmarking, and build transparent salary bands.
  • Manage PTO/FTO tracking, leave administration, and compliance with multi‑state U.S. employment requirements, while also considering international contexts where applicable.
  • Maintain and improve HR systems, documentation, and SOPs that support scale and clarity.

Performance management and development

  • Lead the design and facilitation of 360 reviews, performance cycles, and goal‑setting frameworks.
  • Coach leaders on addressing performance gaps, and support the creation of development plans and performance improvement plans where needed.
  • Help define and refine career paths across coaching and operational teams, with clear expectations and progression criteria.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, feedback, and clear ownership across the organization.

Employee relations

  • Serve as a senior, neutral point of contact for employees and leaders navigating complex concerns, feedback, or interpersonal issues, particularly in U.S. contexts.
  • Manage sensitive issues with discretion, consistency, and fairness, balancing individual needs and organizational priorities.
  • Advise leadership on communication approaches, change management, and practices that reduce friction and misalignment.

Compliance and risk management

  • Ensure HR practices align with applicable federal, state, and local U.S. employment regulations, and coordinate on international compliance as needed.
  • Own the ongoing maintenance of employee handbooks, policies, and documentation, ensuring alignment with legal requirements and organizational values.
  • Lead and document investigations, corrective actions, and HR‑related risk mitigation with professionalism and attention to detail.

Organizational development and scaling

  • Design and refine scalable HR processes that support continued growth, including in the U.S. and global markets.
  • Provide people‑related insights and data to inform decisions about structure, headcount planning, and cultural impact.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in Human Resources, People Operations, or a similar field, with substantial U.S.-based experience.
  • Background in high‑growth, entrepreneurial, or service‑based organizations.
  • Deep understanding of U.S. employment law, including multi‑state compliance; international HR experience is a plus.
  • Demonstrated track record of building and scaling HR processes and programs from the ground up.
  • Strong communication, facilitation, active listening, and conflict‑resolution skills, including with senior stakeholders.
  • High level of confidentiality, integrity, and emotional intelligence.
  • Ability to balance empathy with accountability, clear expectations, and data‑informed decision‑making.
  • Proficiency with HRIS systems and modern project management tools; experience with Asana or similar platforms is preferred.

Benefits

  • Salary: $3,500 - $4,500 USD/month
  • Flexible time off + Holidays

Seniority level

  • Mid‑Senior level

Employment type

  • Full‑time

Job function

  • Other
  • Industries: IT Services and IT Consulting

  • Manutenção Básica: Realiza a manutenção e limpeza preventiva dos equipamentos de trabalho, como verificação de filtros e bicos;
  • Segurança (NR 34): Segue rigorosas normas de segurança, utilizando equipamentos de proteção individual (EPIs), incluindo proteção respiratória, devido à poeira e alta pressão;
  • Segurança e Inspeção: Trabalho em conformidade com normas (como NR-33 e NR-35), realizando inspeção visual para garantir a espessura e qualidade da pintura;
  • Imprescindível disponibilidade para viajar e ficar alojado;

O Parque das Aves é uma das únicas instituições do mundo focada na conservação de espécies da Mata Atlântica, imersivo e encantador.
