Aqui você pode ter uma experiência completa de conexão e conhecimento sobre os animais e o bioma, um patrimônio natural de importância global.

Venha fazer parte da nossa equipe e unir esforços para que juntos possamos cumprir o propósito de cuidar da Nossa Mata Atlântica e suas espécies.

Atividades

  • Realizar atividades de manejo no ambiente do Parque das Aves e do Centro de Reprodução de Espécies Ameaçadas (chácara);
  • Organizar os materiais e equipamentos necessários para realizar as atividades rotineiras de manejo e fornecimento de alimentos para os animais;
  • Fornecer alimentos e água aos animais, conforme estabelecido pela área responsável, preenchendo, quando necessário, as informações em documento específico;
  • Contribuir para o monitoramento da estrutura física dos recintos, informando ao superior imediato e demais membros da equipe sobre necessidade de manutenção e quando necessário, realizar intervenções a fim de manter o bem-estar e/ou evitar fuga dos animais;
  • Realizar atividades manutenção, limpeza e conservação, contribuindo para que os recintos, equipamentos e materiais estejam limpos, o ambiente organizado, as estruturas íntegras e realizar demais atividades necessárias para o bem-estar dos animais;
  • Monitorar as condições físicas e comportamentais dos animais, comunicando a equipe e superior imediato qualquer intercorrência que possa prejudicar a saúde e bem-estar dos animais;
  • Realizar vistoria nos recintos e ninhos para identificar qualquer situação que possa comprometer o bem-estar dos animais, como possíveis predadores, animais não habilitados para o ambiente (serpentes, roedores e afins), com posterior realização de medidas necessárias, conforme orientação do superior imediato;
  • Conferir a quantidade de animais em cada recinto, seguindo os protocolos definidos;
  • Realizar manejos agendados ou emergenciais para contenção física, conforme estabelecido em protocolos que visem movimentação de animais, incluindo recebimento e/ou destinação para instituições externas;
  • Contribuir para a execução de processos de certificação e/ou acreditação relacionados às atividades de manejo animal;
  • Coletar materiais e realizar ambientação de recintos, bem como oferecer vegetações e substratos, conforme orientação do superior imediato;
  • Contribuir com o oferecimento pontual de itens de enriquecimento ambiental, em parceria com as áreas responsáveis, realizando observações comportamentais sempre que necessário;
  • Comunicar imediatamente à equipe e superior imediato qualquer intercorrência/alterações relacionadas aos animais, a estrutura, equipamentos, materiais e falta de insumos;
  • Realizar encaminhamentos imediatos de animais apáticos e/ou doentes para a área responsável;
  • Acompanhar as interações dos animais com os visitantes no ambiente do Parque das Aves, fazendo as interações e atendendo as ocorrências quando necessário e conforme orientação do superior imediato;
  • Realizar o controle de temperatura e umidade dos recintos, registrando as informações em documento específico, conforme orientação;
  • Utilizar materiais e recursos apropriados na execução das tarefas zelando pela segurança física e sanitária, obedecendo os procedimentos específicos adquiridos em treinamentos para o seu uso;
  • Cuidar dos materiais utilizados, bem como organizar e limpar o local de trabalho, removendo resíduos, lixo e material para descarte;
  • Executar os protocolos de segurança e de comunicação determinados institucionalmente;
  • Realizar atividades com animais em todas as dependências do Parque das Aves seguindo protocolos sanitários estabelecidos pela a área responsável;
  • Participar do rodízio de sobreaviso conforme escala, seguindo o protocolo institucional, atendendo os chamados e se deslocando imediatamente ao Parque das Aves;
  • Realizar as atividades sob sua responsabilidade, utilizando equipamento de proteção individual e de proteção coletiva;
  • Contribuir com a recepção de estagiários compartilhando os conhecimentos adquiridos e a rotina de atividades;
  • Prestar suporte ao gestor e à equipe e realizar outras atividades relacionadas.

Requisitos

  • Carteira de motorista - categoria B
  • Desejável experiência em manejo de animais em zoológicos, criadouros ou empreendimentos relacionados.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
## Job Description# The world of customer experience isn’t just evolving—it’s being revolutionized. At Zendesk, we don’t watch the future unfold. We build it. As the architects of the AI-powered Resolution Platform, we’re resetting the standard for what customer service—and customer success—can mean on a global stage.## **Mission**Consider the Zendesk Customer Success Manager (CSM) role if you are ready to be a pioneer in the future of Customer Experience (CX). This is a dynamic advisory position that puts you at the forefront of leveraging Zendesk's cutting-edge AI technologies to guide customers directly to their desired business outcomes. You will gain full ownership of your customer relationships, acting as an orchestrator and strategic partner, responsible for driving product adoption, articulating clear ROI, and accelerating growth. If you are driven by accountability, have a strong technical understanding of SaaS/AI, and want to make an outsized impact on customer success and Zendesk's growth trajectory, this role offers the perfect platform for innovation and career acceleration.## **Overarching Objective for the role:*** Proactive customer health management through intentional, outcome-driven customer engagement, leveraging Zendesk’s advanced solutions, including cutting-edge AI technologies.* Product adoption acceleration and value realization, acting as an evangelist for Zendesk’s AI and automation capabilities, partnering with customers to articulate ROI and provide tailored adoption roadmaps.* Cultivating, strengthening, and accelerating growth of Zendesk customer relationships by applying technical understanding of Zendesk’s products and AI capabilities to advise customers on solution fit, configuration, and integration.## **How You’ll Make an Impact*** Take full ownership of customer relationships, proactively managing their success throughout the entire lifecycle—from onboarding and outcome realization to renewal. You will be accountable for customer health, retention, and advocacy, always seeking new ways to add value.* Deliver outcome-driven engagement across each stage of the customer journey by leveraging customer experience (CX) management best practices. You’ll design and execute success plans, coordinate onboarding with Professional Services, and continuously optimize the customer experience.* Champion product adoption and value realization, acting as an evangelist for Zendesk’s AI and automation capabilities. You will partner with customers to articulate ROI, provide tailored adoption roadmaps, and celebrate success.* Apply your technical understanding of Zendesk’s products and AI capabilities to advise customers on solution fit, configuration, and integration. You’ll serve as a knowledgeable guide for both technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating features into real-world value.* Identify commercial opportunities within your accounts by maintaining commercial acumen—spotting whitespace for expansion, leading renewals based on demonstrated business impact, and driving revenue growth through strategic engagement.* Use analytical capability to interpret customer data and health metrics, proactively uncover trends, and make informed recommendations. You’ll prioritize accounts, forecast renewals, and surface risks and opportunities using data-driven insights.* Build strategic partnerships with customers by operating as a trusted advisor. You’ll facilitate long-term success planning, foster executive relationships, and collaborate cross-functionally to align on mutual goals and innovation.**What You’ll Need to Succeed**## **Customer Focus & Ownership*** Proven track record of taking customer ownership: demonstrating accountability for outcomes and proactively driving customer value across the relationship.* Experience in CX management, orchestrating seamless end-to-end experiences, gathering and applying feedback, and working toward continuous improvement.## **Business Acumen & Strategy*** Business-oriented mindset with commercial acumen: able to understand customer business models, identify opportunities for growth, and connect product adoption to revenue drivers.* Ability to form strategic partnerships—developing deep, consultative relationships, co-developing success plans, and serving as an innovation partner.### **Technical & Product Expertise*** Strong technical understanding—comfortable learning new technologies and quickly grasping Zendesk’s advanced AI features, integrations, and scalability.* Natural adoption and value evangelist who passionately champions Zendesk’s full potential, coaches stakeholders on new capabilities, and communicates impact to drive both engagement and retention.### **Data & Analytical Skills*** Analytical capability: skilled in interpreting customer usage data, monitoring health scores, quantifying impact of adoption, and prioritizing actions based on analysis.### ## Há mais de 120 anos, nos reinventamos a cada dia e nos desafiamos em tudo o que fazemos, sendo impulsionados pelo trabalho de cada uma das nossas pessoas colaboradoras.

  • Certification in Lean, Six Sigma, or other relevant methodologies is highly desirable.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to engage stakeholders at all levels.
  • Proficiency in project management tools and techniques.
  • Ability to lead and inspire teams in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Key Competencies

  • Leadership: Ability to lead and influence teams to achieve organizational goals.
  • Strategic Thinking: Capability to align improvement initiatives with long-term business objectives.
  • Collaboration: Strong ability to work across departments and build relationships with stakeholders.
  • Adaptability: Flexibility to manage change and navigate complex challenges.

Additional Information

The ideal candidate will be passionate about fostering a culture of excellence and innovation while driving impactful changes across the organization. This position offers opportunities for professional growth and the ability to make a significant contribution to the company’s success. title: Human Resources Director Brazil
description:
At Diaverum , we are looking for a business-oriented and hands-on HR Director to lead our HR function in Brazil. This role is critical in attracting, developing, and retaining top talent while ensuring a positive, inclusive, and compliant work environment.

Everyone deserves a fulfilling life. That’s why we’re dedicated to enhancing the lives of renal patients.

As a global leader and the largest independent renal service provider in Europe, we have 13,000 healthcare professionals caring for around 41,000 patients across 450 clinics in 24 countries globally . We provide renal care personalized to patients’ needs and choices, offering a portfolio of treatments ranging from preventive care, hemodialysis, peritoneal dialysis and home care, to the coordination of patients’ comorbidities and holiday dialysis.

Our vision is to transform renal care, delivering and broadening access to the highest quality of kidney care for patients around the world . At the heart of what we do is our standardized care delivery model, continuously evolving digital & AI infrastructure and people caring for patients with competence, passion and inspiration.

Headquartered in Malmö, Sweden, Diaverum is part of the M42 group of companies , a first-of-its-kind integrated health powerhouse committed to the sustainable future of health.

Diaverum Brazil ranks first in the number of patients within the Diaverum group and is the second-largest player in the Brazilian market. The company provides renal services through its own clinics and as a third-party provider for hospitals, treating 4,500 chronic patients across 12 clinics, performing 75,000 treatments per month. Headquartered in São Paulo, its clinics are located in the São Paulo metropolitan region and the state of Sergipe, while also serving hospitals in São Paulo, Sergipe, Bahia, and João Pessoa. Diaverum Brazil has a team of 1,200 direct employees and 200 contracted nephrologists. The HR team consists of 16 members, with two based at the headquarters and the rest distributed across the clinics. With an average business growth of over 30% per year, the company is currently developing and deploying HR IT systems in a dynamic, flexible, and multidisciplinary environment.

As a key member of the Management Team , you will play a pivotal role in driving the HR strategy, talent development, employee relations, and compliance with local labour laws , ensuring alignment with global HR standards and company goals.

Reporting to the Country Manager Brazil, this role is based in São Paulo (headquarters in the Vila Olímpia neighborhood) and requires between 20% and 40% local travel.

  • Develop and implement a business-driven HR strategy , supporting the organizational structure with leadership.
  • Act as an ambassador and change agent , ensuring that Diaverum’s culture and values are a living reality.
  • Represent HR in the Country Management Team and Brazil in the global HR team , contributing to continuous improvement projects.
  • Be a visible and hands-on partner for senior leaders, managers, and employees.
  • Ensure labour law compliance and provide guidance on employment matters.
  • Equip clinic managers with HR tools to become strong “people managers.”
  • Support in talent acquisition, performance management, compensation, and development .
  • Oversee payroll, contracts, and HR administration .
  • Manage the full employee lifecycle , including recruitment, onboarding, engagement, and performance reviews.
  • Support M&A activities , ensuring a seamless HR operational transition .
  • Lead workforce planning , ensuring talent attraction and retention.
  • Contribute to budget planning and labour efficiency initiatives with Finance and Operations.
  • Measure and report on key HR data to drive decision-making.
  • Develop and implement HR policies and procedures aligned with corporate standards.
  • Ensure HR tools are available and used effectively across the business.
  • Educate managers and employees on HR processes, including creating employee handbooks and onboarding materials.

People & Organizational Development

  • Lead organizational design initiatives with the management team.
  • Drive learning & development, ensuring training programs support business needs.
  • Oversee employee onboarding, ensuring a strong integration into Diaverum’s culture and values.
  • Lead succession planning for key management roles and specialists.
  • Implement the annual performance appraisal process, ensuring clear goal setting and development plans.
  • Support restructuring initiatives to optimize the organization’s effectiveness.
  • Oversee payroll and benefits administration , ensuring compliance and efficiency.
  • Implement a structured annual compensation review process based on market benchmarks and performance.
  • Develop compensation strategies that drive a high-performance culture .

ABOUT YOU

You have 8-10 years of experience in HR across multiple disciplines and a proven track record in leading change within multilevel organizations . Your strong business acumen allows you to align HR strategies with company goals, and you have an in-depth understanding of Brazilian labour law . You have worked in an international environment , and if you have experience in the healthcare industry , that’s a big plus. You hold a university degree in HR, Finance, or a related field , and you are fluent in English . You are comfortable using MS Office and other HR tools to support business operations.

You are a customer-focused HR leader with strong relationship-building skills. You take a hands-on approach , ensuring HR strategies are not only well-designed but also effectively executed. Your communication, listening, and coaching skills allow you to support both employees and managers, creating a positive and productive work environment. As a change agent , you have the ability to lead HR transformations and integration processes, making a real impact on the business. You have a continuous improvement mindset , always striving to optimize processes and enhance the employee experience.

If you have experience in an international company and a background in the healthcare industry , that would be a plus!

If you’re ready to take on a strategic and operational HR leadership role in a fast-paced, global environment , we’d love to hear from you! Apply now or reach out for more details.

At Diaverum, we value diversity and are committed to equal opportunities. We strive to create an inclusive workplace environment for everyone, welcoming applicants regardless of ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity, religion, disability, sexual orientation, age, or marital status.

About the project:

At Nortal, we know great talent doesn’t wait for job openings. That’s why we’re building a community of passionate professionals for future opportunities.

These proactive searches align with the profiles our trusted clients seek regularly. Join our "Future Talent" network to be among the first considered when the right opportunity arises.

With over 160 new hires every year, we are constantly expanding our team with passionate and skilled professionals who want to make an impact.

As a Senior Salesforce Developer , you will serve as a subject matter expert for Salesforce development, drive architectural decisions within the platform, and mentor team members across multiple cross-functional projects. You will collaborate closely with business analysts, product owners, and external vendors to ensure the Salesforce ecosystem supports strategic business objectives.

How your day-to-day work will look like:

✅ Design, develop, and implement custom solutions on the Salesforce platform using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, and Flows.

✅ Extend standard Salesforce functionality through robust custom development and configuration.

✅ Maintain clean, scalable, and well-documented code that adheres to Salesforce best practices.

✅ Design scalable and secure Salesforce architecture, aligning with business goals and system performance requirements.

✅ Integrate Salesforce with external systems (e.g., ERP, billing, or internal data platforms) using REST APIs, middleware, or third-party tools.

✅ Evaluate and recommend architectural enhancements or refactoring opportunities to improve platform performance and sustainability.

✅ Work closely with business and product managers to gather and interpret functional and technical requirements.

✅ Translate requirements into actionable technical designs and scalable implementations.

✅ Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to planning, estimation, and sprint reviews.

✅ Conduct code reviews and technical design reviews to ensure quality and consistency.

✅ Share expertise on Salesforce releases, platform changes, and new development approaches.

✅ Implement unit tests, integration tests, and participate in UAT to ensure robust solutions.

✅ Collaborate with QA and DevOps teams to embed quality into the CI/CD pipeline.

✅ Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and Salesforce features to recommend enhancements and optimizations to existing implementations.

✅ Keep current with the latest Salesforce platform features, AppExchange products, and development tools.

✅ Identify and propose improvements to business processes and user experience through Salesforce.

✅ Drive innovation by evaluating and adopting new Salesforce tools or design patterns.

This would make you the ideal candidate:

✨ Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

✨ 7+ Years of experience working in Salesforce development and platform customization.

✨ Deep knowledge of Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and platform tools (Apex, LWC, Visualforce, Flows).

✨ Experience with integrations (REST/SOAP APIs, middleware, Salesforce Connect, etc.).

✨ Proficiency in version control and DevOps tools (Git, Copado, Gearset, or similar).

✨ Hands‑on experience with automation and release management best practices.

✨ Advanced English Level is required for this role as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons.

title: Engineering Manager, MAAS
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager as we expand the MAAS team . Our mission with MAAS ("Metal as a Service") is to provide the best solution for building and running private bare-metal infrastructure, putting a cloud-style on-demand API in front of physical server provisioning, network configuration, and storage. We are hiring engineering managers with experience in high-quality software development and high-performance team leadership who also have deep familiarity with Linux on physical servers, Linux storage and data center networking capabilities.

The Canonical MAAS team is responsible for delivering our Metal As A Service (MAAS) hyperscale provisioning technology. Ubuntu strives to be the most scalable, cloud ready server distribution and MAAS is our platform to get Ubuntu on bare metal servers. MAAS is a rapidly evolving software stack written in Python and Go. Its components span the entire software stack: from low-level hardware detection and provisioning, to the upper level management web interface, API, and CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.

Canonical is seeking passionate technical leaders who are eager to drive innovation in one of Canonical's flagship data center products. You will play a key role in reshaping the future of data center technology through open source management platforms. MAAS aims to revolutionize data center management at scale starting from day zero deployment to long term data center expansion and maintenance.

Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence team and company culture, facilitate technical delivery, and guide strategy and execution. In addition to these responsibilities, you will be expected to collaborate across engineering. The MAAS team regularly interfaces with teams responsible for cloud-init, LXD, and our public cloud offerings.

The successful candidate will have technical leadership attributes and can demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems.

Location : This is a work-from-anywhere position available in EMEA or the Americas.

What we are looking for in you

  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) and a background in Computer Science
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Proven experience delivering software using Python, Golang, or similar languages
  • Experience with Linux system administration (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Familiarity with modern Linux cloud computing technologies, including networking, storage, containers and K8S
  • Technical aptitude for understanding complex distributed systems
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with agile software development methodologies
  • Ability to mentor, develop, and support team members
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills

  • Typescript using modern web frameworks such as React, Angular, Svelte or Vue
  • Data Center infrastructure management and design

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we\'ve been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior/Lead AI Software Engineer (Full Stack) to build and scale intelligent, AI-driven products from concept to production in rapid iteration cycles. This role is pivotal in architecting end-to-end AI solutions—leveraging LLMs, RAG pipelines, vector databases, and Rust or Golang—to power high-performance, low-latency applications. You’ll shape scalable AI architectures, automate workflows, and drive innovation in a fast-growing environment that values ownership, speed, and technical excellence.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Architect and develop robust, scalable AI-powered features across frontend and backend;
  • Design and implement end-to-end AI solutions , from data ingestion to model integration and user-facing interfaces;
  • Rapidly gather business and technical requirements and translate them into functional AI demos within 1–2 weeks;
  • Integrate LLMs and AI services (e.g., APIs, vector databases, RAG pipelines) into production-ready applications;
  • Work deeply in the existing web app codebase, enhancing core modules and integrating AI capabilities;
  • Architect high-throughput, low-latency systems that scale reliably;
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Engineering;
  • Maintain high standards for documentation, testing, observability, and code quality;
  • Lead technical initiatives to automate manual workflows using AI and improve system reliability.

MUST HAVES

  • 5+ years of full-stack development experience
  • Experience in Rust or Golang
  • 2+ years of AI/ML engineering experience building or integrating AI-driven systems
  • AI-assisted code experience with tools such as GH Copilot, Cursor, or Windsurf
  • Proven ability to gather ambiguous requirements and independently develop AI prototypes/demos within short timelines (1–2 weeks)
  • Strong experience working with LLM APIs , prompt engineering, embeddings, and vector databases
  • Experience designing scalable AI architectures (RAG, agents, model orchestration, evaluation pipelines)
  • Proven ability to navigate and improve large, production-scale codebases
  • Strong understanding of performance optimization, system design, and low-latency architectures
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills in a fast-moving team environment
  • Demonstrated experience deploying AI features into production environments
  • Upper-intermediate English level

NICE TO HAVES

  • 2+ years of team lead/management experience
  • Strong skills in Python
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience with cloud platforms and AI tools such as Vertex on GCP, SageMaker, Bedrock from AWS, and similar ones
  • Experience with AI frameworks/SDKs (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, etc.)
  • Experience building AI agents or multi-agent systems
  • Start-up mindset: comfortable experimenting, iterating quickly, and tackling ambiguous challenges

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth: Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
  • Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.
  • Flextime: Flexible schedule with remote and office options.

Meet Our Recruitment Process

It includes main stages: Application → Coding Challenge → Video Interview → Technical Interview or Interview with the Hiring Manager(s). Each step helps us understand your skills and overall fit. If it’s a match, you’ll receive an offer.

title: Consultor Manutenção Mecânica - secagem
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027.

Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação.

Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência

Garantir que equipamentos e sistemas da sua área de atuação, funcionem de forma eficiente e segura, evitando paradas não programadas e interrupções da produção por manutenções de emergência, através de monitoramento de desempenho e demais indicadores, assegurando custos de manutenção adequados, planos de manutenção eficientes e gestão técnica dos times de manutentores.

  • Criar e otimizar planos de manutenção preventiva, preditiva e corretiva, dos equipamentos de sua área de atuação, estabelecendo cronogramas de manutenção e garantindo e execução da manutenção com a eficiência necessária evitando quebras e impactos na produção;

  • Trabalhar em colaboração com o time de engenharia, produção e segurança, apoiando e executando projetos de melhorias, inovação, modificações e modernização de instalações, máquinas e equipamentos, normas e planos de manutenção, identificando causa raiz, apresentando soluções corretivas e preventivas, evitando recorrências, otimizando custos e aumentando a disponibilidade das máquinas e equipamentos;

  • Implantar, monitorar e analisar diariamente os indicadores de desempenho da sua área de atuação (Custos, disponibilidade, produtividade, estoque de peças de reposição etc.), viabilizando ajustes no planejamento, procedimentos e nos processos;
  • Auxiliar na gestão dos custos da sua área de atuação, realizando a previsão do orçamento anual de (Spend e Headcount), incluindo custos de peças, mão de obra e outros recursos, assim como, acompanhar mensalmente os custos realizados, alocando corretamente nas contas contábeis, apresentando e validando com o gestor imediato durante as reuniões de análise crítica, visando o cumprimento do orçamento e otimização dos custos;

title: Data & AI Consultant – Graduate – São Paulo, Brazil
description:
About Thorogood

Thorogood is an independent, specialized, Data & AI consulting firm that works with some of the biggest and best-known companies around the world. We have offices in London, Philadelphia, Boston, Singapore, São Paulo, and Bangalore, and we work as a global unit to service blue chip customers drawing from data-rich sectors such as consumer goods, pharmaceuticals, insurance, and financial services sectors. Together, we compete on the basis of our specialism, our people, high quality, and assured delivery.

We help our customers leverage the latest technologies to make timely, data-driven business decisions. Our multi-skilled teams understand the critical interplay of data engineering, data science, and data visualization. We work across these areas to create business-focused, end-to-end technology solutions robust enough to meet enterprise needs. We recognize the importance of environmental sustainability, both in how we work and in the solutions we build for our clients. Our services span strategy, implementation, advanced analytics services, user empowerment, and support.

About the Position

Overview

Our team members are expected to have a strong interest in business. Understanding our clients’ organizations and industries is key to identifying areas of opportunity for us to help. Similarly, our people must have excellent listening, writing, and presenting skills, alongside the aptitude and motivation to master multiple data-focused technologies in a fast-moving field. This combination of business, people, and technical skills is essential.

Our Brazil and US entities are managed together under one Thorogood Americas in support of development of our business in the region. Further, we work with colleagues across the US, UK, India, Singapore, and Brazil, and with global customers, to provide effective solutions. The ability to work collaboratively and effectively as part of a distributed team is imperative.

Our most successful consultants develop a well-rounded set of skills in each of these areas of business, people, and technology. You’ll do so via a number of opportunities:

  • Comprehensive training: During your first months at Thorogood, experienced consultants will introduce you to the technologies we work with, the industries we serve, and the ways in which we develop our business. Crucially, we will share how we live our values. When you’ve finished, we’ll plan to integrate you into both internal and client project initiatives.
  • Building your core technology skills: We’re the kind of people who learn best by doing. You’ll be working on a team locked onto business value for the customer to develop fast, effective, and high-quality technical solutions.
  • Working with top clients: Thorogood works with some of the biggest and best-known companies in the world. You’ll be a part of client interactions, sometimes leading them, to make sure we’re keeping our projects on track and delivering value to our customers.
  • Developing relationships: We consider ourselves trusted advisors for our clients. We earn this trust through listening carefully, sharing the expertise we have acquired, and helping to progress the objectives within their organizations.
  • Shaping future projects: We are always listening to customers to understand their objectives and needs and working with our consultants to share proposals on how we can help.
  • Working as part of a supportive project team: You’ll be working from our offices, with occasional travel internally or externally to client sites. Your project teams will comprise consultants across many levels of experience, working together daily to support one another along the way.
  • Becoming an expert, yourself: Our subject matter experts are not necessarily the most tenured people at Thorogood. In the rapidly changing world of Data & AI, we look to all levels of experience to gain expertise in new technologies and analytical techniques.

In addition to project work, Thorogood consultants run our company, thus it’s expected from them:

  • Help to grow our business: Interact with current and prospective clients, listen to their needs, and drive business development activities and discussions. Together, we’ll consider the business objectives in conjunction with the technical possibilities in order to understand the opportunities for their organizations.
  • Deliver educationally focused marketing events: Prepare and present informational events for contacts at prospective and current clients.
  • Develop our consultancy: Contribute to recruiting, training, and managing our people.

Additional Benefits

We individually select each of our consultants very carefully through our comprehensive interview and assessment process. We place a great deal of value on consultants’ growth and wellbeing. In addition to a challenging and rewarding career path, Thorogood offers the following benefits:

  • Very competitive salary and compensation program
  • Company-sponsored health coverage
  • Incentive programs
  • Opportunities for national and international travel
  • Focus on work-life balance

Location and Timing

This position is based in our São Paulo office. Our consultants are currently working in a hybrid model and are expected to work in São Paulo-SP, Brazil. The expected start date for this position is January 2026 or July 2026, depending on candidate start date availability.

About You

Qualified candidates must have:

  • Fluency in written and spoken English and Portuguese
  • Strong interest in business, people, and technology
  • Strong academic record in a related discipline, including engineering, computer science, mathematics, statistics, business, management, or another business and quantitative-focused field
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with graduation between November 2024 and June 2026

Candidates must demonstrate effectiveness in:

  • Working individually and as part of project teams
  • Maintaining responsibility and accountability for quality and work delivery
  • Client focus and relationship management
  • Time management and priority setting
  • Data awareness and business interest
  • Learning new technologies

This is an entry-level position; no prior full-time employment experience is required . Please do highlight if you have studied or worked with:

  • Cloud Data & AI technology platforms, e.g. Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform
  • SQL, Python, R, Scala, Spark, or any other programming or statistical programming languages and frameworks
  • Applied mathematics, statistics, probability, machine learning, or artificial intelligence
  • Structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data storage, transformation, or analysis

How to Apply

Your application must include both your résumé and a short video describing your interest and ability to succeed in this position, provided entirely in English . Please submit your application here .

description:

2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Developer Relations Engineer role at Canonical

As the publisher of Ubuntu we serve millions of developers, building for the cloud, IoT and data science. We aim to make open source easier and more reliable for innovators and enterprises.
We have created a new Developer Relations team to engage directly with open source communities and developer-centric organisations. We hope both to communicate our vision and products for better open source development experiences, and also to have a better feedback loop from those audiences to shape our offerings and priorities.
A Developer Relations Engineer is a technical expert, strategist and communicator with deep empathy for developers. This discipline combines practical engineering skills with firm diplomacy across organisational boundaries, in both directions. Like our audience, a Developer Relations Engineer is never satisfied with the status quo, and is driven by an insatiable curiosity to find better ways to get things done. They are problem-solvers and inventors, who understand people's needs and love the way that tools can be adapted to meet them. They stay current with tech trends and provide insights and guidance while fostering innovation.
To improve your chances of success in this application, read our advice on how to get a job at Canonical.
Location : we are building our initial DevRel team in Europe, Middle East, African and American time zones
What your day will look like
In a typical day, a developer relations engineer might:

  • take part in team product meetings, at levels from strategy to day-by-day development progress, contributing insight and expertise
  • maintain conversations with developer community members wherever they may be found - IRC, social media, product forums, meet-ups and more
  • work with colleagues in other teams in the company, as part of efforts to help establish commonality and consistent approaches
  • help solve specific technical problems that users or colleagues have identified
  • contribute to technical documentation to ensure that developer users' needs are met there
  • work on technical articles, presentations or workshops
  • identify new opportunities and directions for improvement in the developer experience we provide
  • present at conferences, meetups or technical events
What we are looking for in you
A strong candidate
  • is a programmer or developer with a demonstrable passion for and engagement in open-source software
  • has worked with real-world challenges developing and deploying software using Linux
  • has practical hands-on experience of Linux software packaging (including Snaps, debs, charms, rocks, PIP, containers)
  • understands current software packing issues and trends in the Linux ecosystem
  • has been a contributor to open-source communities, software and documentation
  • is an engaging, vivacious speaker and presenter
  • can work effectively, tactfully, empathetically and confidently in contexts where different parties have different perspectives, needs and understanding
  • builds trust, relationships and confidence
  • is willing to travel globally twice a year for company events, as well as to upstream and partner events
Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring
  • previous experience in a developer advocacy or community role
  • in-depth familiarity with Ubuntu and the Canonical ecosystem of products
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
A Jaguar Mining está comprometida em promover a diversidade e a inclusão em sua equipe, e, por isso, encoraja indivíduos de diferentes origens e identidades a se candidatarem a esta oportunidade.

Estamos empenhados em criar um ambiente de trabalho mais equitativo, onde valorizamos as características únicas de cada pessoa. Queremos evoluir junto com a sociedade, e esse é um passo fundamental para alcançarmos essa meta.

Estamos à procura de pessoas que se identifiquem com nossa cultura e que desejem contribuir para o nosso crescimento. Junte-se a nós nesta jornada em direção a um futuro mais inclusivo e diversificado.

Venha fazer parte do nosso time como Engenheiro(a) de Segurança do Trabalho.

Principais Atividades

  • Gerenciar riscos ocupacionais e apoiar a atualização do PGR (Programa de Gerenciamento de Riscos), em conformidade com a NR-22.
  • Conduzir avaliações de risco, inspeções de campo e análises de acidentes e quase-acidentes, garantindo a execução das ações corretivas e preventivas.
  • Analisar indicadores de desempenho (taxas de frequência e gravidade, desvios, quase-acidentes) e propor planos de ação baseados em dados.
  • Contribuir com projetos de engenharia segura, apoiando novas frentes de lavra ou expansões.
  • Elaborar e revisar procedimentos operacionais e de segurança aplicáveis às atividades subterrâneas (lavra, ventilação, transporte, explosivos, manutenção, etc.) e outros processos produtivos.
  • Planejar, ministrar e controlar treinamentos legais e técnicos de segurança (NR-22, NR-33, NR-35, uso de EPI, resgate e emergências em mina).
  • Supervisionar e interpretar monitoramentos ambientais e ocupacionais (gases, poeiras, ruído, calor, ventilação).
  • Acompanhar auditorias internas, externas e fiscalizações (MTE, ANM, Corpo de Bombeiros), garantindo o atendimento às não conformidades.
  • Participar da elaboração e execução do Plano de Ação de Emergência (PAE) e dos simulados de evacuação e resgate na unidade.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento de cultura de segurança comportamental, promovendo a participação e o engajamento das equipes operacionais.
  • Promover campanhas de sensibilização e programas de cultura de segurança, incentivando comportamento seguro e reporte de desvios.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento de lideranças de segurança (supervisores e encarregados), fortalecendo o papel deles como multiplicadores.
  • Atuar em conjunto com Geotecnia, Ventilação, Operação de Mina, Manutenção, Saúde Ocupacional e Meio Ambiente, garantindo integração das práticas de segurança.
  • Apoiar investigações de eventos de estabilidade geotécnica e quedas de rocha sob a ótica da segurança do trabalho.
  • Manter indicadores de desempenho de segurança atualizados e propor planos de melhoria contínua.

Soft Skill

  • Ser embaixador da marca Jaguar
  • Praticar os nossos valores
  • Liderança pelo exemplo e influência positiva
  • Comunicação assertiva e escuta ativa
  • Trabalho em equipe e colaboração
  • Capacidade analítica e visão sistêmica
  • Proatividade e senso de dono
  • Resiliência sob pressão e foco em resultados
  • Orientação para melhoria contínua e inovação

Requisitos

  • Formação em Engenherias
  • Especialização em Segurança do Trabalho
  • Gestão de Riscos Ocupacionais e PGR (NR-22 e NR-09)
  • Análise e investigação de acidentes (árvore de causas, 5 porquês, ICAM)
  • Leitura e interpretação de normas técnicas e legislação trabalhista e minerária
  • Conhecimento em higiene ocupacional (poeira, gases, ruído, calor)
  • Uso de softwares de gestão de segurança e relatórios (Power BI, Excel avançado, SAP-EHS, etc.).
  • Registro no CREA ativo.

Desejável

  • Domínio de sistemas de gestão (ISO 45001, SGSSO, PDCA)
  • Gestão de emergências e ventilação em mina subterrânea
  • Desejável experiência em Mina Subterrânea ou setores equivalentes (óleo & gás, siderurgia, energia).
  • Experiência com novas tecnologias de monitoramento de segurança
  • Certificações em Primeiros Socorros, Resgate em Mina
  • Participação em projetos de cultura de segurança ou Safety leadership.

- Serve as a “concierge” for deals, maintaining fluid communication and alignment across functions to drive successful client onboarding;

- Maintain a sales/consulting mindset throughout the technical discovery process, ensuring proposals align with targeted business outcomes.

UX & Presentation Design Acumen: solid grasp of user experience (UX) principles and design thinking, enabling effective discussion of digital product experiences; proven track record of creating high-quality, visually engaging presentation decks and proposals.
- Technical Savvy & SDLC Knowledge: a deep understanding of the software development lifecycle—from conceptualization through to market release—and familiarity with agile methodologies; capability to discuss technical nuances without losing sight of the business impact, bridging the gap between technical details and strategic outcomes.
Analytical & Strategic Thinking: strong analytical skills to synthesize complex information, identify key insights, and recommend actionable strategies; ability to prioritize client objectives while balancing technical feasibility and business goals.
- Team Collaboration & Cross-Functional Coordination: demonstrated ability to work effectively across multiple departments, managing internal communications as deals move from the funnel stage to the kickoff; capability to serve as a liaison, ensuring alignment and clarity among Sales, Engineering, and Recruiting teams.

title: Especialista de Desenvolvimento de Negócios (Biz Dev)
description:
Você terá a oportunidade de estruturar um canal de receita do zero, com liberdade e autonomia, atuando de forma empreendedora. Sua atuação terá visibilidade para a alta liderança da companhia e irá se reportar diretamente para o CRO da Conta Azul. Terá impacto direto no crescimento da companhia com resultados ainda em 2025, podendo se tornar um importante canal de receita, com oportunidades claras de crescimento de carreira e potencial liderança com estruturação de um time especializado.

Será necessário aprendizado e entendimento profundo de modelos de franquia e licenciamento, pois esse será o seu principal nicho de atuação inicialmente. Você será responsável por desenvolver negócios e fazer as primeiras vendas para grupos econômicos que tem a necessidade de apurar o resultado financeiro consolidado e que atuam com rede de franqueados / licenciados (PMEs). Portanto, você irá efetuar uma venda consultiva com múltiplos stakeholders (CFO, franqueador/licenciador, unidades franqueadas ou licenciadas). Este é um nicho ainda não explorado pela Conta Azul, apesar de já termos validado essa oportunidade de mercado.

A Conta Azul é movida pela crença que todo empreendedor merece ter sucesso. Apesar do dia a dia cheio de responsabilidades, queremos que todo dono de um pequeno negócio consiga tempo para se dedicar ao que sempre sonhou quando decidiu abrir uma empresa. Por isso, usamos a tecnologia para criar uma plataforma em nuvem, onde o empreendedor juntamente com o seu contador, de forma simples e fácil, podem encontrar tudo o que precisam em tempo real. Buscamos pessoas motivadas neste propósito. Se você é esta pessoa, junte-se a nós!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Construir e validar o perfil ideal de cliente (ICP).
  • Realizar prospecção outbound (CFOs, Controllers, Diretores) - Inside Sales e Field Sales.
  • Conduzir reuniões diagnósticas e orquestrar POCs com suporte do time de produto e tech.
  • Trabalhar com áreas de RevOps e Pricing para montar propostas comerciais.
  • Alimentar CRM com dados estruturados e gerar insights de canal e reportar semanalmente aprendizados, gargalos e potenciais para escala.
  • Estabelecer relações comerciais duradouras com foco em geração de valor mútuo.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Capacidade de gerar interesse e marcar reuniões com decisores a partir do zero.
  • Habilidade para mapear segmentos, qualificar leads e interpretar padrões de comportamento. Utiliza dados de forma inteligente e sistemática. Faz leitura de dados para construir soluções e tomar as decisões. Acompanha métricas e entende seus reflexos nas estratégias, planos e resultados. Utiliza-se de analises para traduzir contextos.
  • Capacidade de compreender o mercado em que a Conta Azul está inserida, soluções do ERP e as dores dos principais segmentos. Entendimento básico das estruturas operacionais e jurídicas de modelos de franquias e licenciamento.
  • Fluência no uso de ferramentas para gerir pipeline e registrar interações com leads.
  • Capacidade de comunicar ideias com clareza, escutar ativamente e construir relações de confiança com diferentes stakeholders. Inclui habilidade de conduzir negociações complexas, alinhando interesses diversos e gerando acordos mutuamente vantajosos
  • Capacidade de agir com iniciativa, senso de dono e proatividade. Implica não apenas propor soluções, mas liderar sua implementação com foco em impacto e resultados ganha ganha, mesmo diante de incertezas ou recursos limitados
  • Transitar bem entre áreas internas (produto, jurídico, marketing, vendas, finanças) para que tenha sucesso na implementação das novas negociações e garanta as amarrações das negociações e pontos chave de contato para o novo cliente.
  • Disposição para aprender rapidamente sobre os modelos de negócio dos prospects.
  • Orientação a metas, com aprendizado contínuo e ajustes táticos conforme necessário.
  • Além do olhar de crescimento, ter a responsabilidade pelo impacto gerado, considerando implicações de longo prazo para o negócio, os parceiros e os clientes. Agir como dono das iniciativas e dos resultados. Priorizr crescimento sustentável, não apenas números de curto prazo e assumir erros e corrige rapidamente com aprendizado.
  • Compreensão de indicadores como LTV, CAC, NMRR, e lógica de canais indiretos.
  • Habilidade de se comunicar com fluência em inglês. Preparar materiais, realizar benchmarks internacionais. Comunica-se com objetividade e clareza utilizando o idioma. Tem facilidade para conduzir reuniões, benchmarks e discussões em inglês. Consome materiais em inglês e tem habilidade de produzir documentos e materiais no idioma.
  • Conhecimento em plataformas que aumentam produtividade em cadências de contato.
  • Ter experiência em venda de software para franqueadores e/ou licenciadores.
  • MBA ou especialização em áreas correlatas (negócios, estratégia, inovação, etc.).
  • Experiência comprovada +3 anos com desenvolvimento de negócios, parcerias ou expansão de mercado (Preferencialmente ter vendido software para licenciadores e franquadores)

Informações adicionais:

  • Plano de saúde com cobertura nacional sem desconto da mensalidade ou coparticipação dos Azuis. Pode se estender aos dependentes (filhos, cônjuges, inclusive de pessoas homoafetivas) conforme política interna;
  • Plano odontológico com cobertura nacional sem o desconto da mensalidade dos Azuis. Pode se estender aos dependentes (filhos, cônjuges, inclusive de pessoas homoafetivas) conforme política interna;
  • Benefício flexível: R$ 1.000,00 para ser investido em educação (reembolso de 70% da mensalidade), idioma (70% da mensalidade) atividades físicas e reembolso referente aos seguintes profissionais: psicólogos(as), nutricionistas, massoterapeutas e fisioterapeutas (50% do custo);
  • Auxílio creche para Papais e Mamães com filhos entre 0 e 24 meses;
  • Auxílio Home Office mensal à partir de R$ 150,00 a depender da localidade;
  • Auxílio Home Office parcela única de R$ 1.500,00 para custear a estação de trabalho;
  • Cartão Flash de vale refeição e alimentação mensal sem desconto;
  • Zenklub: sem limite de sessões no mês para consultas com Psicólogos, Psicanalistas, Terapeutas e Coaches. As duas primeiras sessões do mês são integralmente por nossa conta, e as demais por R$ 20,00 cada;
  • Benefício Farmácia: App Vidalink com subsídio de 75% para medicamentos com receita para todos os Azuis. Pode se estender aos dependentes (filhos, cônjuges, inclusive de pessoas homoafetivas) conforme política interna;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas.

Pacote de Experiências:

  • Baby Blue Time: jornada menor de trabalho com flexibilidade extra de horário nos retornos das licenças Maternidade e Paternidade dos nossos Azuis;
  • Days Off Experience: Todos os Azuis com mais de 1 ano de casa poderão ter 4 folgas no ano;
  • Sabático Parcialmente Remunerado: período em que os Azuis elegíveis podem ficar off e ainda recebem uma graninha antecipadamente;
  • Seguro de vida: sem desconto;
  • Ambiente inovador que proporciona crescimento, com profissionais incríveis e de aprendizado constante;
  • Escritório com acessibilidade, que estimula a criatividade e produtividade, com comida e bebida à vontade;
  • Horário flexível (trabalhamos de segunda a sexta).

Overview

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US: If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

About the Role

As a Sales Engineering Delivery Manager, you will serve as the crucial link between our prospective clients and internal teams. In this role, you will lead technical discovery sessions and consultative introduction calls, gather essential engagement details (such as timelines, budgets, skillset requirements, risks, and SWOT analyses), and translate these insights into impactful proposals. This position requires a strong grasp of both business strategy and the software development lifecycle (SDLC), along with outstanding communication and design skills to create engaging, high-quality deliverables.

Responsibilities

  • Technical Discovery Call & Stakeholder Engagement: Assemble Sales Support Engineering team, align them on preliminary information, following internal RACI procedures; Lead the Technical Discovery call, showcasing interpersonal skills to build rapport and trust quickly; Demonstrate in-depth knowledge of the SDLC—from ideation and inception through discovery and development to market release; Use consultative questioning to uncover client pain points and business objectives, extracting and analyzing high-level requirements (timeline, budget, skill needs, risk); Present clear, persuasive client-facing communications during calls and emails.
  • Proposal Development & Deliverable Creation: Develop dynamic, visually compelling presentation decks and engagement proposals that articulate service offerings, project scope, value propositions, and strategic recommendations; Customize deliverables to reflect client-specific challenges uncovered during discovery; Integrate technical insights with business strategy to address immediate deliverables and long-term client growth.
  • Team Buildout & Project Kickoff: Act as the primary coordination point among Sales, Recruiting, and Engineering; ensure smooth handoffs from initial engagement through team buildout to project kickoff; serve as a concierge for deals and translate complex technical aspects into digestible, business-focused narratives; maintain a sales/consulting mindset to align proposals with targeted business outcomes.

Qualifications

  • Exceptional Communication & Soft Skills: outstanding interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport and trust quickly; strong presentation and storytelling abilities for clear client-facing communication.
  • UX & Presentation Design Acumen: solid grasp of user experience (UX) principles and design thinking; proven track record of creating high-quality, visually engaging presentation decks and proposals.
  • Technical Savvy & SDLC Knowledge: deep understanding of the software development lifecycle—from conceptualization through market release—and familiarity with agile methodologies; ability to discuss technical nuances without losing sight of business impact.
  • Analytical & Strategic Thinking: strong analytical skills to synthesize complex information, identify key insights, and recommend actionable strategies; ability to prioritize client objectives while balancing technical feasibility and business goals.
  • Team Collaboration & Cross-Functional Coordination: demonstrated ability to work across multiple departments, managing internal communications as deals move from funnel to kickoff; ability to serve as a liaison across Sales, Engineering, and Recruiting.
  • Consultative Sales Experience: prior experience in a pre-sales, sales engineering, or technical consulting role, ideally within a digital software consultancy or similar environment; ability to quickly assess client needs and translate them into actionable insights and proposals.
  • English: Upper Intermediate

Perks & Benefits

  • Professional growth: mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
  • A selection of exciting projects: opportunities with Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
  • Flextime: flexible schedule with options for remote work or office presence.

Job Details

  • Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type: Full-time
  • Industry: IT Services and IT Consulting

This is a highly transactional, full-cycle role where you will grow your buyer portfolio while closing +300 deals per month . You will work with a qualified lead pool of roughly 15,000 potential buyers and convert both outbound and inbound demand into closed business.

You will run the entire sales cycle : prospecting, outbound calling, qualification, pricing, negotiation, and closing. Once buyers are activated, 70 to 80 percent of your revenue will come from repeat purchases, allowing you to scale your portfolio fast.

Selling into the US market requires strong English skills, speed, commercial judgment , and the ability to operate in a fragmented buyer landscape. Experience working with American customers is highly preferred.

Location

Where you'll be based and how we collaborate globally.

Our headquarters is located in the heart of Hamburg, Germany, with team members distributed across the globe. This is a hybrid position based in São Paulo, Brazil , where you’ll regularly collaborate in person with local colleagues to share ideas and drive customer success while having the flexibility to work from home as well. Since you’ll be targeting the U.S. market, U.S. time zone is required.

🚀 Your Impact

What you'll own, drive, and contribute to our success.

In this role, you will directly shape the future of container trading by helping us build the distribution channel for the entire industry — giving buyers access to a unified global inventory, transparent price competition, and standardized fulfillment and guarantees. Your work will have a measurable impact on growth, customer experience, and market expansion.

  • Build and manage a portfolio of US buyers and close high volumes of container deals
  • Conduct high outbound activity to find and convert demand, supported by a strong inbound engine
  • Work with fast sales cycles and maintain momentum across hundreds of deals
  • Match customer needs with available inventory and negotiates pricing and margins effectively
  • Use AI powered sales tool stack to maximize buyer experience and sales to track leads, monitor sales performance, and gain insights to continuously improve conversion rates

What Makes You a Great Fit?

The experience, skills, and mindset that will help you thrive.

We believe attitude beats years of experience. We’re looking for someone with a winning, competitive mindset — someone who treats every deal as an opportunity, thrives under high volume , and brings the drive needed to succeed in a fast-paced, transactional sales environment .

You’re a great fit if you:

  • Have hands-on B2B sales experience with strong outbound and cold-calling skills - ideally within a fast-paced transactional sales environment
  • Thrive in transactional sales and can manage 300+ fast-cycle deals per month
  • Own the full sales cycle end to end — from outbound prospecting and qualification to negotiation and closing
  • Are self-sufficient in pipeline generation , proactive in outbound activity, and confident converting warm leads from our strong inbound engine
  • Are comfortable selling to the US B2B market and navigating a fragmented landscape of many smaller customers with frequent repeat purchases
  • Communicate clearly, negotiate confidently , and manage a large pipeline with discipline
  • Think entrepreneurial , act proactively, and stay organized and motivated while handling many fast-moving opportunities
  • Bring drive, resilience, and a success attitude where every deal counts

What to Expect

Insights into perks, culture, and earning potential.

Uncapped Earning potential: Our commission model rewards true hunters. With high transaction volumes and fast cycles, your results directly drive your income.

Ownership & impact at xChange: You will have a direct stake in xChange as a shareholder with a competitive virtual equity package! You will also have full ownership and trust to drive impactful topics, supported by smart and driven individuals. Plus, get personal coaching and counseling ...

Entrepreneurial freedom: You run your own pipeline, own your deals, and can make immediate impact from day one.

xChange culture & collaboration: Our diverse and talented team operates with flat hierarchies and a growth-focused mindset which fosters an open-minded, collaborative, and high-performance driven culture where A-players thrive.

AI Focus: We believe AI is a game-changer for sales success. At xChange, you’ll get hands-on experience with AI tools designed to streamline sales operations, enhance your skills, and boost your conversion rates. This is a unique opportunity to grow alongside AI technologies that will empower you to work smarter and close more deals.

Other perks at xChange: 36 off days for remote employees outside of Germany, mental healthcare & coaching program, language courses and many more. Feel free to ask the Talent team for details 😊

description:
Vaga presencial em Florianópolis | 44h semanais | Salário competitivo

Porque se juntar a nós

Dynamox é uma empresa de alta tecnologia que desenvolve soluções inteligentes de monitoramento de vibração, temperatura, corrente e tensão, ajudando equipes de manutenção e confiabilidade a tornarem a indústria mais segura, eficiente e sustentável.

Hoje, somos a única empresa mundial na área de manutenção com as certificações internacionais ISO 27001, 27701, 27017 e 27018, além da ISO 9001.

Além de processos bem estruturados, acreditamos em pessoas. Aqui, você encontra um ambiente organizado, colaborativo e orientado à melhoria contínua, onde o aprendizado é incentivado e excelência faz parte do dia a dia. Valorizamos quem busca evoluir, inovar e fazer a diferença.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Executar o desenvolvimento de sistemas embarcados;
  • Atuar na evolução e manutenção de produtos existentes;
  • Realizar a interface com as demais equipes do setor de desenvolvimento;
  • Executar testes funcionais, de validação, unitários e paramétricos;
  • Desenvolver documentação de projetos no Jira e nos recursos da plataforma Microsoft;
  • Conduzir a elaboração de documentos técnicos e com a pesquisa de inovações tecnológicas;
  • Dar suporte técnico, contribuindo com as demais equipes quando solicitado;
  • Contribuir e disseminar práticas de segurança de informação e privacidade de dados confidenciais e restritos, no que diz respeito às rotinas do departamento e empresa.

Requisitos

  • Programação em C/C++ para sistemas embarcados, atuando em ambientes bare metal ou com RTOS, incluindo desenvolvimento de drivers, controle de periféricos e depuração de baixo nível;
  • Conhecimento sobre protocolos e interfaces de comunicação embarcadas, como Modbus, CAN, SPI e RS-485, com experiência em integração de sensores, atuadores e dispositivos industriais;
  • Experiência em integração de dispositivos, otimização de uso de memória e processamento, gerenciamento de dados em tempo real e desenvolvimento com foco em operações de baixo consumo energético;

  • Conhecimento sobre protocolos de rede aplicados a dispositivos conectados, como HTTP, TLS, DNS e NTP, considerando requisitos de segurança e confiabilidade;
  • Experiência com tecnologias de comunicação sem fio e conectividade embarcada, como Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Ethernet e redes móveis.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de ferramentas e automação de processos utilizando linguagens como Python, C# ou C++, especialmente para testes, validação, integração contínua ou suporte ao desenvolvimento embarcado;
  • Conhecimento em integração com bancos de dados e serviços em nuvem, como SQL, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, S3 ou similares, no contexto de soluções IoT e telemetria;
  • Familiaridade com protocolos industriais adicionais, como OPC, e integração com sistemas de supervisão ou plataformas industriais.

Formação

description:
Software Engineer, Backend (All teams) – Brazil – Vaga para mulheres

Engineering the future of logistics – from Brazil to the world

This role is part of our commitment to increase the representation of women in technology at DoorDash Brazil. We strongly encourage candidates who identify as women to apply.

We are building an engineering team where women have equitable access to opportunity, leadership, and long-term career growth within our São Paulo hub.

At DoorDash, we believe diverse teams build better products. This opportunity is designed to create greater equity in access to engineering roles and long-term career growth within our São Paulo engineering hub.

DoorDash is building the world’s most reliable on-demand logistics platform. As part of our global expansion, we are investing heavily in Brazil and growing our engineering presence in São Paulo. This is a unique opportunity to join one of Silicon Valley’s fastest-growing companies—while staying close to home.

We’re looking for Backend Engineers who are excited to solve real-world problems at scale. You’ll work on product teams or platform teams that power our three-sided marketplace of Consumers, Dashers, and Merchants . From improving restaurant discovery to optimizing delivery logistics, you’ll help shape the experience of millions of users.

You’ll work alongside experienced engineers, product managers, and designers—many based in the U.S.—so fluency in English and strong collaboration skills are essential.

What you’ll do

  • Design, build, and maintain large-scale backend systems used by millions of users
  • Contribute to our technical roadmap and define the architecture for key product areas
  • Drive improvements in performance, scalability, reliability, and security
  • Help transition parts of our monolithic codebase to a microservices architecture
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Brazil and the U.S.
  • Work on high-impact features that directly improve the user experience for Dashers, Merchants, or Consumers

We’re excited about you because…

  • You have 1+ years of experience with backend technologies and distributed systems
  • You’re comfortable with modern web architecture (HTTP, REST APIs, grpc, microservices)
  • You’ve worked with relational and non-relational databases
  • You enjoy solving complex problems with elegant code and clear thinking
  • You’re fluent in English and confident participating in meetings and code reviews in English
  • You care about quality and write tests to ensure your code works as expected
  • You take ownership and enjoy working with autonomy in a fast-paced environment

Nice to haves

  • Experience working at a tech company with scale
  • Familiarity with Java, Kotlin, or similar JVM languages
  • Exposure to big data technologies or event-driven architecture
  • Interest in mentorship or growing into a technical leadership role

Why join DoorDash Brazil?

  • Work on a global product, with real impact on millions of people
  • Be part of a fast-growing engineering hub in São Paulo
  • Hybrid remote model with great office space in Av. Paulista
  • English immersion and opportunities to grow your international career
  • Contribute to a modern, scalable platform used across multiple countries
  • Build the future of local commerce with a team that values ownership, humility, and getting 1% better every day
  • Be part of a growing engineering organization committed to building inclusive teams and equitable opportunities

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We\'re committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

This position is open to candidates with disabilities. DoorDash welcomes applicants registered with the national autism registry (SisTEA) and others who seek an inclusive workplace. If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.
